title: WHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Site WHS Manager will be responsible for partnering site operations and to execute company safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, this individual will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates. The WHS manager must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. The WHS Manager must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. This individual must instruct and train Operations Leaders in company safety policies and assist the operations site teams in incorporating our safety standards at their site. The WHS manager will be required to identify best practices and incorporate these best practices into our standards to continuously improve company safety policies. The WHS manager will be required to possess excellent safety program and relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge and demonstrates this expertise when working with Operations. The WHS Manager will be responsible to lead a WHS & Safety team members: Safety Specialist, Safety Coordinators, Onsite first aid Associates. They must communicate safety team expectations and give frequent and appropriate feedback to their safety teams and ensure they are executing to the core competencies of an Amazon safety professional.

Key job responsibilities
4+ years previous experience in Environment, Health & Safety
Possess a thorough understanding of local/regional regulations and company policy.
Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies.
Measure sites’ performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
Analyze safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
Perform frequent site safety audits to identify all non-compliance equipment and/or processes at the site. Implement solutions to eliminate exposure to these risks and prevent injuries
Audit record keeping practices and Genuine entries to ensure compliance to global safety standards and local regulations.
Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
Manage and mentor Safety Associates in your assigned FC.
Spend time at the site and seek input from Safety teams, Associates and leaders on safety program improvement opportunities. Ensure open communication on status of progress and resolution against these suggestions.
We have a 5-day work week but given the 7 days a week operation, the 2 scheduled days off will vary based on shift patterns and business needs.
Ensure site leadership and Associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy. Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in safety, environmental, ergonomics or a related field required.
- 4+ years previous experience in Environment, Health & Safety.
- Experience building and managing a high-performing team of direct reports

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing operations environment
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Experience leading the development of department strategy
- Master's degree in Health and Safety or a related field
- Government Certified Safety Professional preferred
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort interfacing with site leaders.

title: Sr. Program Manager, Data Center Planning
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Data Center Planning team is searching for a passionate and talented leader to drive our Global Build and Capex Operational Planning cycles. AWS is at the forefront of a rapidly changing industry, facing new and complex challenges that have never been tackled before. This role will lead organization wide programs to support critical operational planning cycles, creating timelines, leading tiger teams, and owning executive communications. This role will also bridge multiple business teams and finance functions by leading 3-year planning for asset categories that are critical to unblocking AWS' expansion plans, including Data Center build, long lead equipment, site and shell. This is a high impact role offering an opportunity to drive and influence business-critical decisions impacting the long-term future of AWS. The ideal candidate for this role is a leader with strong business judgment, a passion for making lasting program improvements, an ability to define strategy and vision, and an ability to align cross-functional organizations and teams around their vision.


Key job responsibilities
- Developing strategy and roadmaps to improve Operational Planning processes. This involves partnering with Finance, Tech and Business teams to automate plan generation and reduce cycle times for building and budgeting plans.

- Creating and scaling mechanisms to review strategic investment opportunities and assess execution risks. This ensures alignment across stakeholders on infrastructure capacity plans for delivering data center space and power.

- Overseeing the execution of operational planning processes. This includes identifying critical paths and removing inefficiencies. It also involves demonstrating strategic thinking on when plans should be updated.

- Developing metrics, reviewing performance against previous plans, and identifying improvements to close gaps.

- Identifying opportunities to simplify processes, mitigate business risks, and implement scalable solutions.

- Communicating ideas clearly to a range of stakeholders and executives to facilitate understanding and buy-in.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

Start your morning collaborating with global teams across time zones
Lead dynamic tiger team sessions to solve complex infrastructure challenges
Develop and present strategic recommendations to executive leadership
Partner with finance teams to optimize multi-billion dollar investment decisions
Drive innovation in data center planning and execution
Mentor team members and foster cross-functional relationships
Shape the future of AWS's global infrastructure footprint


Impact You'll Make
Drive critical operational planning cycles that shape AWS's global presence
Lead 3-year strategic planning for essential infrastructure components
Influence billion-dollar decisions that define AWS's future
Create lasting improvements in how we plan and execute massive-scale projects

About the team
Join the AWS Data Centre Planning team, where we're not just building data centers – we're architecting the future of cloud computing. Our team of visionaries and innovators tackles unprecedented challenges in cloud infrastructure, making history every day while having fun along the way. As our Global Infrastructure Strategy Leader, you'll orchestrate AWS's worldwide expansion through strategic planning and execution. You'll be at the helm of transformative initiatives that directly impact how millions of customers experience cloud computing.

Basic qualifications

- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- 3+ years of program or project management experience

title: Health and Safety Engineer, Data Center Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Join the world class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of supporting the largest cloud computing infrastructure team as a Regional Safety Engineer. As the Regional Safety Engineer you will own the Health and Safety function of your respective area. You will be responsible for improving the health and safety of our data centers, advancing safety culture, and protecting our employees. Each day you will work with our data center engineers, the people who make the cloud go. They are working with electrical switching equipment, large scale air handling mechanical systems, and critical IT gear.

You will work closely with experts in security, construction, operations, logistics, compliance, corporate counsel, and human resources to further the global health safety program. You will partner with employees as well as contractors to achieve health and safety goals and improve our already strong safety culture. As AWS increases data capacity you will partner with construction managers to ensure risks are identified and mitigated prior to live operations. You will work in a fast-paced environment where our operations are rapidly changing, advocating safe changes in the face of new infrastructure, new tools, and new products/processes.

This role is for an experienced Safety Specialist or Safety Engineer. The role's prime responsibility will be to support the safety operations for Data Centers.
You will be part of a regional and global team that works with internal and external partners to maintain and enhance the safety of operations. Close collaboration with onsite physical security, vendors, compliance officers, risk management, and fire/life safety systems is required. Additionally, you will work with employees and contractors to achieve specific safety objectives.

You must be an effective communicator, sending clear, concise and consistent messages verbally, in written form, and/or public speaking forums. You will advise, instruct and train company personnel on safety policies and procedures, as well as assist the teams in incorporating and improving our safety standards at their sites.

You will report to the Regional Safety Manager – EMEA and be responsible for continuing to enhance the safety of operations and construction. Some domestic and international travel is required.

Key job responsibilities
- Support implementation of health and safety standards, policies and practices including but not limited to; safety management systems, training, risk assessments, assist with industrial hygiene assessments, and applicable safety regulations.
- Conduct health and safety audits of all Data Centers to ensure compliance with health and safety requirements as well as life safety requirements.
- Ensure compliance and implementation of global health and safety programs that exceed regulatory requirements.
- Develop health and safety plans for on-site emergencies, business continuity, and other unique events.
- Maintain safety record keeping and data integrity.
- Perform data trend reviews to present to cluster leadership to support business and safety initiatives.
- Consult and partner with the AWS H&S Program team and legal teams for interpretations and guidance.
- Identify risks and partner with Operations to mitigate them
- Daily interactions with our customers delivering health and safety guidance.

Key Requirements & Important Aspects

Mobility & Transportation: Our data centers are located in areas with limited public transport connectivity. Having a valid driver's license and reliable personal vehicle are required for regular commuting to our facilities.

Work Environment: This is a 100% onsite role due to the hands-on nature of Health & Safety Engineering and the requirement to conduct regular site inspections and assessments.

Team & Language: This is a regional EMEA team of Health & Safety Engineers. English is our official working language, and all interviews will be conducted in English. Advanced English proficiency is required for the role.

title: Interactive Designer II, Amazon Ads - Brand Innovation Lab
descriptionHtml:
Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) creates custom advertising experiences for the world's biggest brands across Amazon's canvas (Alexa, Fire TV, Prime Video, Twitch, Brand Stores, and more). We're looking for an Interactive Experience Designer to join our team.

This role is visual design, with part UX design and part build. You're the connective tissue between the campaign vision and the finished experience. You bring solid design intuition and a hunger for innovation to every project, and you can bring design-based problem-solving skills to the table at every step of a campaign's life. You translate client objectives and creative feedback into bar-raising design solutions that enhance our customers' lives, then bring those solutions to life in Figma and Webflow.

Key job responsibilities
You work alongside other Interactive Designers, Art Directors and Writers to design mocks for the physical and digital components of a campaign experience. You bring the skeleton framework to the campaign build, plus the campaign skin that makes the pitch believable. You own the customer journey and wireframe components.

As a campaign moves into production, you:
- Ensure art direction and copy elements are translated into visual design through layout, typography, and CX.
- Conduct user testing as needed to dive deep into customer behavior and inform design decisions.
- Ensure client asset delivery is accurate and optimized for creative use.
- Design high-fidelity layouts in Figma and build production-ready pages in Webflow, owning the experience from comp to code.
- Deliver bar-raising pre-production design files for creative and client review.
- Incorporate internal and client feedback with speed and skill.
- Work closely with the DT on file hand-off to ensure the experience is elevated at every step, with an eye towards accessibility standards.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a creative brief for our newest sponsorship program, then jump into Figma to iterate on high-fidelity layouts for a current campaigns landing page. After lunch, you're building a production page in Webflow while syncing with your Design Technologist on component hand-off and accessibility. Later, you join a creative review with your CD and Art Director to push a pitch concept further, then close out the day prepping mock-ups for a client presentation across two concurrent campaigns.

About the team
Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) is an award-winning team that conceptualizes and executes bespoke advertising experiences for global brands—including Nike, P&G, Hyundai, Pepsi, and Google—who invest in media with Amazon Ads, scaling successful campaign elements as new products or features in existing products. Our global team of storytellers and innovators includes creatives, strategists, design technologists, engineers, producers and more, collaborating to create customer-obsessed solutions across the Amazon canvas (Alexa, Twitch, Prime Video, Fire TV, etc.) that are customized to our advertisers' goals.

Basic qualifications

- Experience owning creative input, development and execution from concept to completion
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

title: Senior Manager, Software Development, Ads Performance Measurement
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is continuing to invest in the measurement of its ads products in order to tap into the growing digital advertising marketplace. Amazon Ads' Measurement, AdTech and Data Science (MADS) team is looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Software Development to lead engineering teams building our Performance Measurement systems.

You will own engineering teams responsible for how advertisers measure the performance of their ad campaigns, combining deterministic approaches with modeled approaches to deliver a complete and trustworthy view of advertising outcomes across channels, devices, and the full customer journey.

This role is at the intersection of big data systems engineering, applied science, and advertiser-facing product delivery. You will lead 30-50 engineers across multiple teams, owning petabyte-scale data pipelines that process billions of events daily, real-time and batch attribution systems, experimentation infrastructure (randomized controlled trials at scale), and privacy-preserving measurement architectures. Your systems directly inform how advertisers allocate billions in ad spend.

You think big, have a bias for action, and bring a history of delivering results in complex distributed systems environments. You thrive in ambiguity and are ready to scale advertising measurement. You are equally comfortable diving deep into system architecture as you are setting multi-year technical strategy with senior leadership.

The right candidate will possess a strong engineering leadership background, will have demonstrated experience building and operating large-scale data and ads systems, and will have a well-rounded understanding of advertising, causal inference, and privacy-constrained computation. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level technical strategy, but can also roll up your sleeves, dive deep into system designs, and unblock your teams when it matters.

You set technical direction, define system architectures, partner deeply with scientists to translate research into production-grade systems, and build engineering organizations that deliver at high velocity. You will work directly with product managers, scientists, and cross-functional teams to define solutions that balance measurement precision with system latency, privacy constraints, and advertiser trust. You drive prioritization, make build-vs-buy decisions, own operational excellence for mission-critical systems, and develop engineering talent across multiple locations.

You will also drive AI-native development practices across your organization, leveraging agentic AI tooling to accelerate engineering velocity, automate operational workflows, and fundamentally rethink how measurement systems are built and maintained. We expect leaders in this role to be hands-on adopters who push their teams toward AI-augmented development as the default.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of engineering experience
- 5+ years of engineering team management experience
- 10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience partnering with product and program management teams
- Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications

title: Principal UX Designer, Amazon Quick
descriptionHtml:
Quick is a business productivity product where people connect their real work — their email, calendars, documents, chat, and enterprise data — and let Quick act across all of it on their behalf. The desktop app is where that promise becomes tangible: it is the persistent, always-on surface where people do their deepest work, orchestrate complex tasks, and trust Quick to operate with full context across everything on their machine and in the cloud.

We are looking for a Principal UX Designer to own the end-to-end design of the Quick desktop app. This is the surface that determines whether Quick becomes indispensable — the place professionals open first, keep running all day, and rely on to stay ahead of their workload. You will define how people interact with an AI that can see their local files, connect to their enterprise tools, run tasks in the background, and surface the right information at the right moment — and you will set the design standards that make that breadth of capability feel coherent, trustworthy, and effortless rather than overwhelming.

Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end design of Quick's desktop app as a single, coherent experience, setting the design direction and standards for every surface a user touches, from first launch to daily habit.

Design how people connect and orchestrate their real work tools — email, calendars, documents, chat, and enterprise data — so Quick can act across all of them with the right context, permissions, and confidence.

Design the agentic surfaces where Quick works on the user's behalf: background tasks, multi-step workflows, proactive suggestions, and autonomous actions, making the breadth of what Quick can do feel trustworthy and in control rather than unpredictable.

Design the information architecture and interaction patterns that let users move fluidly between conversations, files, knowledge, and task management without losing context or momentum.

Design for power users and knowledge workers specifically, where depth, speed, keyboard fluency, and persistent workspace matter more than simplification, and where structured, discoverable entry points coexist with open-ended AI interaction.

Partner deeply with Product, Engineering, and Platform teams to translate the unique capabilities of a native desktop app — local file access, background execution, system-level integration, cross-device continuity — into experiences that feel seamless rather than technical.

Set and evangelize desktop design standards across Quick, and raise the bar for how quality, coherence, and craft show up across every surface of the app.

Mentor and provide design leadership to other designers, acting as the design authority on the desktop experience and the connective tissue between desktop, web, and mobile.

About the team
You will join the UX team behind Quick, working alongside designers, PMs, Scientists and engineers building a business productivity product that people trust with their most sensitive work. This role owns the admin portal, the control plane where organizations govern what Quick can do. It is a space where the right patterns are still being invented, and where your design leadership sets the standard for how compliance and governance show up across the product.

Basic qualifications

- Extensive years of design experience, with a portfolio that demonstrates principal-level scope and impact.
- Experience designing and delivering complex, end to end software products, not just individual features or screens.
- A track record of owning ambiguous, systemic design problems across many connected surfaces.
- Demonstrated ability to influence product direction and design standards across multiple teams.
- Excellent systems thinking and communication skills, with a history of aligning cross-functional partners around a shared design vision.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing enterprise products, especially admin, permissions, security, or governance surfaces.
- Experience designing for both end users and administrators, balancing individual usability with organizational control.
- Familiarity with designing for AI systems that act on a user's behalf, including consent, oversight, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
- A track record of setting design standards and mentoring other designers as a design authority.

title: Procurement Manager, APAC Procurement Excellence Team
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンは、数億種類に渡る商品をお客様へ提供し続けることによって、世界的に認知度が高く、グローバルリーディングカンパニ—としての地位を確立しています。また、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業”であり続けるため、日々改善と改革を行っており、それらの業務へ貢献できる経験豊富な人材を求めています。

グローバル調達事業部 アジアパシフィック調達本部 （英語名称: APAC Procurement）は、グローバルの調達組織におけるアジアパシフィックエリアの中核部門として調達プロセスの構築・実行・改善に取り組んでいます。APAC Procurementはグローバル調達事業部 (GPO: Global Procurement Organization) およびアジアパシフィック地区 (APAC: インド、オーストラリア、シンガポール) の調達部門、エンジニアリング部門やオペレーション部門、ファイナンス部門と連携し、「品揃え」「低価格」「利便性」を継続的に向上させることがミッションです。様々な専門分野の調達のプロフェッショナル人材が国境を越えて闊達な議論を行って、最良の調達ソリューションを提案し、数ヶ月後にはそれが実際のコストセービングとなって直接会社そしてお客様に数字で貢献できるところに仕事の面白さと醍醐味があります。
APAC Procurementの主な調達品は、物流拠点のローンチ・オペレーションに必要な搬送機械設備(MHE)・ロボット・棚(Storage)・ファシリティ等の設備や関連工事から、梱包資材、電力やビルメンテナンスといったサービス等の多岐にわたります。さらに、APAC ProcurementではAPACの調達組織と連携したプロジェクトの統括、管理をしています。

Key job responsibilities
Amazon’s Global Procurement Organization (GPO) is seeking a Procurement Manager to drive procurement standardization, governance enhancement, and process improvement across APAC Region. This role is critical to establishing consistent procurement practices, strengthening compliance frameworks, and leading transformative initiatives that optimize how Amazon procures goods and services in the APAC region. The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of strategic procurement leadership and operational excellence, working cross-functionally with internal stakeholders across APAC countries to elevate procurement capabilities and deliver measurable business impact.
1. Procurement Standardization & Governance
Design, implement, and continuously refine procurement standards, policies, and operating procedures for APAC, ensuring alignment with GPO global frameworks. Establish governance mechanisms that drive consistency in sourcing decisions, vendor management, and contract execution across all procurement categories. Develop and maintain compliance frameworks to ensure adherence to internal policies and regulatory requirements, conducting periodic assessments to identify gaps and implementing corrective actions. Lead the creation of standardized templates, decision matrices, and approval workflows that reduce variability and increase auditability in procurement activities.
2. Process Improvement & Optimization
Identify, prioritize, and execute process improvement initiatives that enhance procurement efficiency, reduce cycle times, and deliver cost savings across APAC. Leverage data analytics, cost engineering methodologies, and benchmarking to diagnose process bottlenecks and develop evidence-based solutions. Drive the adoption and localization of global procurement tools and systems, collaborating with digital technology teams to ensure seamless integration with existing APAC workflows. Manage end-to-end project execution for improvement initiatives, from opportunity identification through implementation and benefits realization, ensuring sustainable outcomes that scale across the organization.
3. Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
Partner with buyer teams, Finance, Engineering, and Operations departments across APAC countries to align procurement strategies with business objectives and secure buy-in for standardization and improvement initiatives. Report regularly to stakeholders—including GPO management, APAC leadership, —in both Japanese and English, through written documentation and verbal presentations, to maintain visibility and secure appropriate support. Navigate complex organizational dynamics under uncertain and ambiguous conditions, employing stakeholder management and risk management skills to build consensus and drive execution. Travel internationally as needed for direct engagement with APAC counterparts, with primary destinations including India,Australia and NA.
AmazonのGlobal Procurement Organization (GPO) では、APAC地域における調達活動の標準化、ガバナンス強化、およびプロセス改善を推進するProcurement Managerを募集しています。本ポジションは、APAC各国の調達活動に一貫した基準を確立し、コンプライアンスフレームワークを強化し、調達のあり方を最適化する変革的なイニシアチブをリードすることが求められます。戦略的な調達リーダーシップとオペレーショナルエクセレンスの接点で活動し、APAC地域の社内ステークホルダーとクロスファンクショナルに連携し、調達組織の能力向上と実測可能なビジネスインパクトの創出を担います。
1. 調達標準化・ガバナンス強化
APAC地域における調達基準、ポリシー、業務手順を設計・導入し、GPOグローバルフレームワークとの整合性を確保しながら継続的に改善する。ソーシング判断、ベンダーマネジメント、契約執行における一貫性を担保するガバナンス体制を確立し、全調達カテゴリーにわたり運用する。社内ポリシーおよび規制要件への準拠を確保するコンプライアンスフレームワークを開発・維持し、定期的な評価を通じてギャップを特定し是正措置を実行する。また、調達活動におけるばらつきの低減と監査対応力の向上を目的とした標準テンプレート、意思決定マトリクス、承認ワークフローの構築をリードする。
2. プロセス改善・最適化
APAC地域全体の調達効率向上、リードタイム短縮、コスト削減に寄与するプロセス改善イニシアチブを特定、優先順位付け、実行する。データ分析、コストエンジニアリング手法、ベンチマーキングを活用してプロセス上のボトルネックを診断し、エビデンスに基づいたソリューションを開発する。グローバル調達ツールおよびシステムの導入・ローカライズを推進し、デジタルテクノロジーチームと連携して既存のAPAC各国のワークフローとのシームレスな統合を実現する。機会の特定から導入、効果実現までの改善イニシアチブのエンドツーエンドのプロジェクト実行を管理し、組織全体にスケール可能な持続的成果を確保する。
3. クロスファンクショナル連携・ステークホルダーマネジメント
APAC各国のバイヤーチーム、ファイナンス部門、エンジニアリング部門、オペレーション部門と連携し、調達戦略を事業目標と整合させ、標準化・改善イニシアチブに対する合意を形成する。GPOマネジメント層、APACリーダーシップ、ステークホルダーに対し、日本語・英語両言語で書面および口頭による定期的な報告を行い、プロジェクトの可視性を高め適切な支援を得る。不安定・不確実・複雑・曖昧な状況下でもステークホルダーマネジメントとリスクマネジメントのスキルを駆使し、合意形成と実行を推進する。プロジェクト推進に必要と判断する場合は海外出張を行い、APACメンバーとの直接的なミーティングやワークショップを実施する（主な出張先：インド、オーストラリア、アメリカ）。

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. title: Director – Automotive & Manufacturing Industry Specialists & Solutions  , AWS Industries
descriptionHtml:
Automotive and Manufacturing is one of AWS's highest-priority industry verticals and a centerpiece of Amazon's broader enterprise strategy. Our vision is to be the most trusted technology partner for the world's automotive and manufacturing companies as they navigate the greatest transformation in their history: the convergence of AI, electrification, and software-defined everything. Three industry forces make this moment urgent: (1) the rapid shift to software-defined vehicles and autonomous mobility is rewriting how cars are built, sold, and operated; (2) generative AI and agentic AI are unlocking a new generation of smart factories, predictive supply chains, and industrial automation at scale; and (3) manufacturers are under intense pressure to reduce costs, localize production, and build resilience against geopolitical and tariff disruption. AWS is uniquely positioned to help customers across all three, and this role is at the center of that mission.

This is a truly global leadership position. You will lead teams spanning North America, Brazil, Europe, Korea, Japan, and India, operating across cultures, time zones, and market dynamics. Beyond AWS, you will coordinate with other Amazon business units, including Alexa+ (voice and ambient AI for automotive), Project Leo (satellite connectivity), Amazon Ads (in-vehicle and retail media), Amazon Supply Chain Services, and Amazon Business, to bring the full breadth of Amazon's capabilities to automotive and manufacturing customers. Few roles at AWS offer this combination of strategic scope, global scale, and cross-Amazon impact.

In this executive-level leadership role, you serve as the Global Industry Specialists & Solutions (ISS) leader for the Automotive & Manufacturing (A&M) Industry Business Unit, leading the industry solutions architecture, business development, and GTM teams that shape how automotive and manufacturing companies adopt AWS at scale. As a leader of leaders, you will build and run a global team driving end-to-end industry-solutions strategy across software-defined vehicle (SDV) and autonomous mobility, customer experience, smart manufacturing, supply chain, and other lines of business areas. You engage with C-level decision makers, VPs of engineering, manufacturing. and other business areas, bringing fluency in cloud and applied AI/GenAI for industry use cases. You operate within a matrixed, global organization, while elevating AWS's thought leadership presence across the automotive and manufacturing industry while collaborating across sales, service teams, and partner organizations to drive transformational business outcomes for customers on their AI-driven journeys

Key job responsibilities
- Define and execute a comprehensive strategic Go-To-Market (GTM) plan for the global Automotive & Manufacturing sector, including industry solution prioritization, repeatable pipeline generation, market segmentation, and competitive positioning.
- Identify, develop, and realize business opportunities to generate customer value and AWS AI/cloud revenue, building a business development pipeline in line with the AWS Automotive & Manufacturing industry strategic direction and multi-year revenue targets.
- Structure and execute Strategic Framework Agreements (SFAs) encompassing Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs) and Cloud & AI deployments at scale with industry leading companies.
- Lead, develop, and grow a global team of specialized senior solutions architect and business development professionals, articulating how AWS can solve challenging industry problems with Agentic AI and cloud, driving accountability, coaching on multi-divisional deal structuring, CxO engagement, providing visible industry thought leadership, and fostering a culture of ownership, high performance, and continuous development
- Serve as the primary strategic advisor to industry executives at the CEO, CFO, CIO, CTO, and VP+ level, building trusted bilateral relationships that span both commercial infrastructure partnerships and enterprise cloud and AI adoption programs

- Define and size market segments; identify, qualify, and engage key customers and strategic industry partners and develop scalable partner engagement and GTM motions
- Drive cross-functional partnership with AWS Product, Engineering, and Service teams to influence roadmap priorities based on customer signals and industry trends
- Pioneer industry solutions and go-to-market motions; identify whitespace opportunities where AWS can lead the automotive and manufacturing ecosystem through innovation
- Collaborate with Sales on qualified opportunities with a clear understanding of the customer's business drivers, stakeholders and urgency
- Establish scalable mechanisms, engagement playbooks, and industry solution frameworks that enable AWS field teams globally to engage confidently and consistently in automotive and manufacturing cloud opportunities
- Partner with Marketing to drive global campaigns, such as IAA, IMTS, CES, and Hannover Messe, highlighting customer success stories and strategic messaging.

Advanced degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or 15+ years of equivalent professional experience in business development, strategic partnerships, engineering, or commercial leadership

15+ years leading global teams in business development, strategic partnerships, or commercial leadership roles in the Automotive & Manufacturing sector

5+ years of working knowledge of cloud computing, AI/ML, or emerging technology paradigms and their application to automotive and manufacturing industry challenges

Experience applying AI/ML and agentic AI services to automotive or manufacturing use cases

Experience structuring and executing large-scale commercial agreements ($100M+) with enterprise automotive or manufacturing customers, including complex multi-party deal structures and long-term strategic frameworks

title: Software Dev Engineer, AWS Elastic Container Service
descriptionHtml:
AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS) is forming a new team in Seattle with a bold mission: dramatically reduce the time it takes for containerized workloads to become ready to run on Fargate. The vast majority of customer tasks are short-lived, making launch speed one of the most impactful levers for customer experience — and we're going after a step-function improvement.

As an SDE on the Workload Optimization team, you'll work at the intersection of container runtimes, operating systems, and networking to optimize the end-to-end launch path. This is deep systems work with direct, measurable customer impact at enormous scale.


Key job responsibilities
- Build and optimize container startup and runtime systems using Linux kernel, containerd/runc, and Bottlerocket
- Design and implement solutions across the container networking and instance preparation stack
- Work on one of the highest-scale container orchestration platforms in the world
- Join a founding team with greenfield ownership and the opportunity to shape technical direction from day one

About the team
Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) makes it easy for customers to run, scale, and secure containerized applications on AWS. ECS powers some of the most demanding workloads on the planet — from startups launching their first container to enterprises running millions of tasks across global infrastructure.

The Workload Optimization team is a brand-new team within ECS, based in Seattle, with a focused mission: fundamentally reduce the time it takes for a containerized workload to become ready to run on AWS Fargate. For the vast majority of Fargate customers, launch latency is one of the biggest factors in their end-to-end experience — and we believe a step-function improvement is achievable.

This is a greenfield team, which means you won't be inheriting legacy systems or processes — you'll be building from scratch. You'll work deep in the systems stack (Linux kernel, container runtimes, OS, networking) alongside a small, senior group of engineers who care deeply about performance, correctness, and customer impact at scale.

We value engineers who think from first principles, are comfortable with ambiguity, and are energized by hard problems that don't have obvious solutions. Our culture is direct, low-ceremony, and high-ownership — you'll have real influence over what we build and how we build it from day one.

title: Transportation Specialist, Amazon Intermodal (AZIM)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Intermodal (AZIM) Operations team is seeking highly skilled and motivated Transportation Specialists to join this rapidly growing team. AZIM Operations drives the end to end operational execution of all loads (internal and external) shipped on our 1P network. The team supports regions and shippers across the Supply Chain network and is tasked with ensuring on-time pickup and delivery of freight from vendors, Amazon fulfillment centers (FCs), rail yards and shipper hubs. In the case of disruptions, the Operations team is responsible for addressing the disruption, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring timely resolution of the issue. The AZIM Operations team is the first line of defense in understanding network trends, delays, dwells and other exceptions that impact AZIM’s ability to deliver a world class transportation product that serves its customers on time.

Key job responsibilities
- Communication with customers (Carriers, Rail Road partners, Vendors/Suppliers) and stakeholders (Program Managers, Fulfillment Centers, Amazon Managed carrier programs).
- Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed.
- Understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
- Rectify disruptions, breaks in process and follow standard work to make decisions that make sense based on available data.
- Provide real-time customer experience by working in a fast paced operating environment.
- Knowledge to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams.
- Deliver follow through on the resolutions to ensure the information is delivered.
- Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed.
- Communication, both verbal and written as their data and findings are critical to tracking trends and performance inefficiencies.
- Identifying possible disruptions in a route and fixing/rerouting it in a timely manner.
- Deliver positive carrier and driver experience/solutions, in a contact center environment, through researching, problem-solving, setting appropriate expectations and working within the Amazon Transportation network to get trailers/trucks back on track when disruptions occur.


A day in the life
The AZIM Transportation Operations Specialist facilitates the continued flow of Amazon’s supply chain by passing information to key stakeholders and resolving disruptions that impact customer experience or the flow of information impacting performance and delivery. The Specialist checks on a list of shipments and makes sure everything is as it should be, then optimizes the driver’s intermodal portions of the trip as much as possible while providing any necessary information to avoid disruptions. Will be required to make real-time decisions to resolve issues and cancelations. Will also be apart of new and inventive programs designed to bridge a gap or improve overall business. The Specialist addresses or escalates any concerns arising during the lifecycle of freight leaving rail ramps, shipper hubs, Amazon fulfillment centers, or transiting between rail to OTR carriers. The day-to day role requires the specialist to provide resolutions by researching and querying internal tools and making real-time decisions in accordance with their guidance and standard work processes. In this role, the Transportation Operations Specialist will be able to understand the process and requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. This position will need to have the experience to understand Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel) experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Are 18 years of age or older

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:

Come build the future with us.

title: Applied Scientist-II, Amazon Music - Search Science, Amazon Music – Search Science
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture.

The Amazon Music Search Science team is seeking an innovative and driven Applied Scientist to join our engineering and science hub in Bangalore. You will work alongside a world-class team of machine learning experts to break new ground in understanding user intent, classifying complex audio and musical forms, and creating next-generation interactive search experiences that help users find the exact music, podcasts, and audio content they are in the mood for.

In this role, you will own the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end machine learning systems. You will balance execution on core search and discovery priorities—such as improving retrieval accuracy, latency, and relevance for millions of daily queries—while laying the foundational modeling capabilities for broader semantic understanding and advanced conversational search experiences across mobile, web, and voice-forward devices (like Alexa and Echo).

Key job responsibilities
- Core Search & Execution: Collaborate with scientists, software engineers, and product managers to define, frame, and solve complex business and ranking problems as machine learning, information retrieval, or optimization tasks.
- Advanced AI & Modeling: Design, build, train, and evaluate production-grade ML models using classical machine learning, deep learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic AI techniques to scale music discovery and intent resolution.
- End-to-End Production Ownership: Take algorithms from research ideation to production deployment. Build scalable data pipelines, efficient model-serving systems, and robust offline/online evaluation frameworks.
- Experimentation & Iteration: Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments across millions of customers to measure impact on search relevance, engagement, and customer satisfaction, refining models for continuous improvement.
- Forward-Looking Innovation: Research and implement novel statistical and machine learning approaches, exploring multi-modal understanding, rich content semantics, and advanced retrieval mechanisms that extend beyond traditional search boundaries.
- Technical Communication: Communicate findings, architectural decisions, and technical roadmaps clearly to both technical peers and executive stakeholders, authoring robust design documents and contributing to team standards.

Basic Qualifications
- PhD, or Master’s degree and 4+ years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience building machine learning models or algorithms for business applications and deploying them into production.
- Strong programming skills in Python, Java, C++, or related languages, with a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
- Experience in one or more of the following areas: Information Retrieval, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Recommender Systems, Deep Learning, or Numerical Optimization.
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with large-scale distributed computing frameworks and big data systems (e.g., Spark, Hadoop, AWS infrastructure).
- Experience building search ranking, query understanding, or semantic retrieval systems for high-scale consumer applications.
- Familiarity with modern foundation models, LLMs, fine-tuning techniques, and efficient inference optimization for production services.
- Track record of peer-reviewed publications or patents at top-tier machine learning/AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, KDD, ACL, SIGIR, ICML).
- Experience in designing, executing, and evaluating rigorous online A/B experiments.

- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

title: Software Engineer - Linux kernel, EFA
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about systems programming at the intersection of hardware and software? Do you want your code to directly accelerate the world's largest AI training and inference workloads? The Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) Drivers team is looking for Software Development Engineers to design and implement the kernel drivers and userspace libraries that power high-performance networking for AWS's AI/ML and HPC infrastructure.

EFA is the custom network interface that enables thousands of GPUs and accelerators to communicate at near-wire-speed bandwidth and low latency, making it a critical enabler of both foundation model training and real-time inference serving at unprecedented scale. When customers train the next generation of large language models or serve billions of inference requests with tight latency SLAs on Amazon EC2 P5, P6, or Trn instances, it's our driver stack that moves the data.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and optimize Linux kernel drivers (RDMA/EFA) and userspace provider libraries (rdma-core) that ship to millions of EC2 instances
- Work directly with custom hardware — collaborate with chip designers to bring new silicon capabilities to life in software
- Contribute to the upstream Linux kernel RDMA subsystem and rdma-core open-source project
- Architect solutions for next-generation networking features: GPU-direct RDMA, adaptive routing, collective offloads, and multi-path transport
- Build monitoring and automation tools to enhance driver testing for functionality, reliability, and performance
- Own the full lifecycle: from initial hardware bring-up and feature enablement through testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting across the global AWS fleet

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience in C/C++
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems
- Experience writing low level drivers
- Experience with DMA, PCIe, or hardware/software co-design
- Contributions to open-source projects or upstream kernel work

title: IP Asset Assurance & Reconciliation Manager , Leo Infrastructure & IP Security
descriptionHtml:
Leo Infrastructure & IP Security is seeking a candidate to develop and own Leo's IP hardware asset assurance program — the independent audit, reconciliation, and accountability function that ensures every piece of Leo IP hardware is accounted for. This role is critical to protecting intellectual property (IP) by establishing a clean separation of duties, maturing the reconciliation program as Leo scales, and converting accountability data into enforceable controls.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in asset assurance, inventory reconciliation, or audit program management within a high-security technology or manufacturing environment. This role serves as the authority on Leo’s IP hardware accountability posture (reconciliation, loss trends, and enforcement-control effectiveness).


Key job responsibilities
• Develop, own, and mature Leo's IP hardware asset assurance
• Execute on the reconciliation methodology, cadence, sampling criteria, and accountability standards for hardware asset system-of-record data
• Serve as the authority on IP hardware accountability posture, translating reconciliation data into risk narratives and recommendations for leadership
• Own verification of enforcement controls; tracker-association gating, assignment caps, and physical-verification requirements for Critical/High-tier hardware, and validate they hold as asset tracking tooling capabilities come online
• Own loss-trend and non-engagement analytics (device loss rate, non-response rate, unrecovered device aging); identify systemic drivers and recommend structural fixes rather than one-off corrections
• Partner with the Security Tooling / MIRA owner to define reconciliation, gating, and accountability requirements built into the system of record
• Drive accountability for unresolved record-reality gaps through structured escalation to leadership with documented risk exposure
• Route reconciliation findings into the unified findings register owned by the Audit & Compliance Manager; this role owns the reconciliation methodology and analytics but not the register
• Feed risk-prioritized reconciliation findings into Investigations to ensure casework is prioritized by verified accountability risk
• Establish and maintain SOPs for reconciliation, discrepancy classification, and closure verification
• Produce recurring accountability and reconciliation reporting for business reviews, including trend direction, risk concentration, and enforcement-control effectiveness
• Partner with the Physical Security Manager and Audit & Compliance Manager to ensure accountability gaps inform design standards and audit strategy


A day in the life
You review reconciliation runs, comparing inventory tracking system records against physical reality, and triage the record-reality gaps that surface, prioritizing anything tied to Critical/High-tier hardware. You verify enforcement controls are holding (tracker-association gating, assignment caps, physical-verification requirements) and work with the tooling owner to define new reconciliation and gating requirements as capabilities come online. You dig into loss-trend and non-engagement analytics to identify systemic drivers behind device loss and non-response, then route risk-prioritized findings into the unified findings register and to Investigations. You partner with the Audit & Compliance Manager and Physical Security Manager to ensure accountability gaps inform audit strategy and design standards, and escalate unresolved gaps to leadership with documented risk exposure. You balance hands-on reconciliation with program maturation, refining SOPs, defending the separation of duties, and preparing accountability posture reporting for business reviews. Every day varies, but the mission stays fixed: every piece of Leo IP hardware has a confirmed location and a responsible party.

About the team
The Leo Infrastructure & IP Security team's IP pillar protects Amazon's intellectual property and hardware assets across the full product lifecycle. Operating under two pillars — Proactive/Detection and Response/Compliance — we deliver IP risk assessments, hardware security engineering, insider-threat detection, OSINT monitoring, secure logistics and destruction, incident response, audit and findings management, and asset accountability. From the moment hardware is built through its final destruction, we ensure every piece of IP has a confirmed location, a responsible party, and secure handling. We partner with engineering, program, and facility teams to embed security into how Leo builds and moves its technology, making the secure path the easiest path so Leo's growth is never slowed by security, but enabled by it.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent technology experience
- 5+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
- Experience analyzing data and creating reports for leadership
- • Experience defining and executing reconciliation or audit methodologies for controlled assets
- • Experience maintaining or auditing chain-of-custody and system-of-record data
- • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate accountability data into actionable business language
- • Bachelor's degree in security management, supply chain, business, information security, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in security services, asset protection, loss prevention, risk management, inventory management, investigations, supply chain, auditing, compliance, or similar
- Experience in auditing, risk management, compliance, program management, or quality management systems
- CISSP, CISA, CISM or other security certification, or Associate's degree or above
- Experience leading controls in manufacturing or complex industrial environments
- Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities
- Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing operations environment
- • Experience defining reconciliation, gating, or enforcement requirements for asset tracking systems (system-of-record platforms, GRC tools)
- • Experience translating accountability data into enforceable controls
- • Familiarity with security audit frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, ASIS standards, or equivalent)

descriptionHtml:
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Senior Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. In this role, you will help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. You will engage with product owners to influence product direction and help our customers tap into new markets by utilizing AWS Services. You will also look for patterns and trends that can be broadly applied across an industry segment or a set of customers that can help accelerate innovation. Along the way, you will get the opportunity to enhance your own body of knowledge and have some fun.

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate and scale existing workloads in the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.

For this role, we are looking for folks who have technical breadth complimented by technical depth in AI/ML Frameworks, or MLOps, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging with Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, and VPs.

descriptionHtml:

工具、園芸・農業資材、リフォーム商材などを取り扱うHome Improvement事業本部は、AVS(ブランドコンサルティング)部門のリーダーを募集します。チームメンバーのマネジメント、ビジネスパートナーであるメーカーのAmazonにおけるビジネスの成長、AmazonのAIを活用したチームの生産性の向上が、本ポジションに期待される役割です。

Home Improvement事業部のAVS部門は、重要なビジネスパートナーであるメーカーやブランドのAmazon上でのビジネスの持続的成長のための戦略立案とその実行支援を行います。イノベーションを重視するAmazonでは、コンサルティングサービスにAIを活用してメーカー・ブランドの成長をサポートします。このサポートサービスの総称をAmazon Vendor Service（AVS）と呼びます。AVSはAmazonのリテール事業領域で重要な「品揃えの拡充」「在庫・物流の最適化」「オペレーションの効率化」「コンテンツ・カタログの品質向上」や「マーケティング」など幅広い手段を網羅します。

このサービスはブランドスペシャリストと呼ばれるチームメンバーを通して提供されます。本ポジションは、リーダーとしてご自身のチームに所属するブランドスペシャリストのマネジメントを行いながら複数のメーカー・ブランドのビジネスの成長を推進します。同時に、ご自身が率いるチーム全体の生産性をAmazonのAIや仕組みを活用して継続的に向上させることも重要な業務です。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

当ポジションが求める人材は、チームメンバーの育成に関心があり、分析力と戦略立案力を持ち、持続的な成長を可能にするイノベーションを推進する力を持った方です。また、Amazonが最も重視する顧客至上主義に強く賛同いただける方を求めています。多くのステークホルダーとの連携を図りながら、変化の速いビジネス環境下でアクションを推進するリーダーシップも求められます。

• 担当するメーカー・ブランド（ベンダー）と年間のビジネス目標とその達成に向けたアクションプランを合意し、良好な関係性を構築・維持しながら計画の実行を行う。

• ベンダーからのエスカレーションに対応し、適切な対策により問題を解決に導く。

Amazonと本事業本部は働きやすい環境の実現を重視します。リモートワーク、フルフレックス制度を導入し、男性社員の育休取得も支援しています。最近ではリモートワークへの支援拡大や、ワークライフバランスの維持と継続的な改善に向けた取り組みを行っています。

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

title: Principal Worldwide Specialist Solutions Architect, Agentic AI, Data & AI GTM
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in defining technical strategies for new services where the problem space is still being written? Are you energized by the challenge of setting adoption strategy for technology that reimagines how AI agents consume governed context at runtime? Are you ready to become the recognized authority for a service that will shape the future of agentic AI?

We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to lead the technical adoption strategy for AWS Context, the organization-wide knowledge graph and agentic context layer for AI agents. This is a formative role where you will define how customers across a segment or territory understand, evaluate, and adopt AWS Context. You will guide customers through AWS Glue Data Catalog building blocks, frame complex agentic use cases across their data estates, and work directly with product teams to shape the service roadmap. Your work will set the technical direction that the entire team executes against, establish mechanisms and reference architectures that raise the bar org-wide, and build the external thought leadership that defines how the market understands agentic context. You will convert the most complex early evaluations into committed adoption, mentor senior Solutions Architects, and create sustained influence well beyond individual customer interactions.

Key job responsibilities
- Set the technical adoption strategy for AWS Context, determining which use cases, industries, and customers to prioritize and orchestrating the evaluation motion other Solutions Architects execute
- Lead the highest-stakes customer engagements personally, framing undefined problem spaces with customer architects and executives, designing agentic solutions that leverage governed context across AWS Glue Data Catalog, Amazon Redshift, Amazon Simple Storage Service, Apache Iceberg, Amazon Athena, Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases, and Lake Formation
- Establish reusable mechanisms, reference architectures, and standards that raise the bar for the team org-wide, codifying what works from field experience into artifacts that accelerate future engagements and ensure consistency
- Influence the AWS Context service roadmap as a strategic partner to product and engineering teams, synthesizing field learnings into succinct business and technical requirements and contributing to early product formation
- Build external technical thought leadership through content creation and speaking engagements that position AWS Context in the market, mentor and develop senior Solutions Architects, and contribute to hiring strategy

A day in the life
A typical day blends strategic direction-setting with hands-on technical leadership on the most complex work. You might refine the adoption strategy for your segment in the morning, prioritizing which agentic use cases and customers to focus on. Then you lead a design session with customer architects and executives, framing how governed context and semantic layers improve agent reasoning across their data estate. Between engagements, you resolve escalated governance and security objections, establish reusable reference architectures for the team, and synthesize field patterns for the service team. You mentor senior Solutions Architects on complex evaluations and prepare external technical content that shapes how the market understands agentic context.

About the team
The customer-facing specialist Solutions Architecture team is the technical engine behind AWS Context adoption. Because the service is evolving toward general availability, we meet customers building agentic applications where they are today: guiding them through the AWS Glue Data Catalog and Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases building blocks available today, proving value against real agent use cases, and capturing the customer interest and requirements that shape the service roadmap. The team owns the evaluation motion across collaborative design sessions, tailored demonstrations, hands-on proofs of concept, and acceleration builds, driving clean handoffs into production onboarding as capabilities become available.

As the Principal Solutions Architect, you set the technical strategy and mechanisms the team operates on. We work closely with sales, service, and product teams, feed field learnings back into the roadmap, and hold a high bar for both technical depth and customer trust. It is a collaborative, high-ownership environment where the most senior architects build the capabilities and standards that make the entire team more effective.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

- Experience building large-scale machine learning and AI solutions at Internet scale

title: Applied Science Manager, Fleet Autonomy, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an Applied Science Manager to lead the team that invents how our autonomous mobile robot fleet thinks - from how robots negotiate shared space to adapting fleet behavior as tasks and deadlines change. This is a rare opportunity to own the evolution of multi-robot coordination in free space at an unprecedented scale.

Proteus is Amazon's first fully autonomous mobile robot and navigates freely alongside people in our fulfillment centers, perceiving its environment and making decisions in real time. The fleet is growing quickly in scale, diversity, and intelligence, with thousands of robots deployed and new platforms including mobile manipulation entering the mix. The science challenge is making a diverse, heterogeneous fleet perform reliably in a world that changes constantly — where priorities shift hour to hour, new capabilities come online, and operational conditions create new constraints.

Your team will own algorithms at multiple layers of this system: how groups of robots autonomously coordinate through intersections and corridors, how fleet traffic is shaped across the road network, which tasks are assigned to which robots and when, and a new fleet orchestration layer that interacts directly with Operations to take in requests, collaborate to solve complex operational challenges, and adapt fleet performance and behavior on the fly.

Whether you've been leading a research team in industry and want a bigger canvas, or you've been driving impactful academic research in close partnership with industry and are ready to make the leap, this is a role where your ideas become fleets of robots, and those robots deliver for hundreds of millions of customers.


Key job responsibilities
• Set the technical vision and research agenda; identify the right problems and sequence bets across near-term production needs and long-horizon research
• Build, hire, and develop a team of applied scientists; provide scientific mentorship and grow careers
• Drive algorithms from research through production deployment in partnership with engineering
• Represent the team externally through publications, academic collaborations, and community engagement


A day in the life
Your internal stakeholders are engineering teams who productionize your algorithms, operations leaders whose buildings depend on fleet performance, and peer scientists building learned models of fleet dynamics. You spend your time shaping research direction, unblocking technical challenges, reviewing experimental results, and partnering across disciplines to get science into production.

About the team
You would join a multi-disciplinary science organization with deep expertise in planning, optimization, machine learning, and robotics — working at the frontier of multi-robot coordination where scale, diversity, and dynamism intersect. Our algorithms ship to real robots within months of conception, and we learn from the operational data they generate. We maintain active academic collaborations and contribute to the research community through publications, workshops, and open problems.

Basic qualifications

- PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
- 5+ years of industry or academic research experience
- 2+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Strong understanding of autonomous mobile robots and how they navigate
- Experience deploying robotic systems into the field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience with mobile robot fleets in industrial or logistics settings
- Experience developing computationally efficient decision making algorithms for live production systems

title: DCEO Chief Engineer, ADC InfraOps DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing systems (MEP) operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

Also expected from the CE is the ability to manage small-to-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

The CE directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

Responsibilities:

- Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.

- Operate independently with limited direct management

- Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed

- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA

- Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams

- Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians

- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

- Ensure all security procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

- Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows

- Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience

- Regularly utilize Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Excel, PPT, Word) and other computer programs such as PDF, QUIP, and other dashboards and scheduling tooling.

- Instruct others on scheduling, ticketing, and provide mentorship in developing solutions.


Physical Requirements:

- Walk job sites in uneven terrain
- Work at heights and from ladders
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more
- Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
- Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
- Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired
- Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
- Push or pull heavy objects into position
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work at depths, such as under raised floors

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of vendor management experience
- 4+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
- 5+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
- 5+ years of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in vendor management
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment
- Experience in data center engineering or operations
- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of construction or project management experience
- Electrical or mechanical Journeyman License
- operating engineering license such as DC II, DC III, or equivalent
- Experience in construction or project management
