title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Communications
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security’s Security Communications (SecComms) team builds and operates the platforms, tools, and systems that enable Amazon’s security organization to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at scale. We support security events, ongoing security programs, vulnerability communications, and strategic initiatives that span multiple Amazon business units and AWS services. Our engineering products are the connective tissue between security findings, remediation owners, and the people responsible for keeping Amazon and its customers safe.

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to drive the design, development, and operation of software systems that power security communications workflows, automation, and integrations at scale. This role is for a builder who brings engineering rigor to ambiguous problems, cares deeply about customer outcomes, and thrives working across organizational boundaries with security engineers, program managers, and communications professionals.

Security Communications serves as the engineering and operations hub for AWS-related security messaging, stakeholder notification, and communications tooling across the organization. Our team is responsible for building scalable platforms that enable consistent, reliable, and timely communication during high-severity security events, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and routine security program operations. We are a cross-functional team — engineers work shoulder-to-shoulder with communications professionals, security operations personnel, AWS service owners, and executives. Candidates should be comfortable collaborating in this environment and contributing to discussions that span both technical and non-technical domains.



Key job responsibilities
Design & Delivery

* Design and deliver software features and improvements spanning the full lifecycle — including scoping, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance — for major portions of the SecComms platform.
* Work backwards from customer and stakeholder needs to define requirements and translate them into well-designed, maintainable software solutions.
* Design cohesive software implementations for difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks; bring clarity to ambiguous requirements and identify simple, extensible designs.
* Balance constraints across new feature development, technical debt, and operational reliability; limit short-term workarounds in favor of sustainable solutions.
* Produce high-quality, well-tested, documented code that adheres to the Amazon Code Bar and can be maintained and extended by teammates who did not author it.

Operational Excellence

* Demonstrate operational excellence in all work; own and operate production services with appropriate alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and on-call response.
* Actively participate in operational support; identify and resolve the root causes of operational issues rather than accepting the status quo.
* Routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve team operational processes, automation, and tooling — do not settle for operational friction when it can be eliminated.
* Ensure that software failures are addressed with permanent fixes; avoid recurring incidents by addressing systemic causes.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Partnership

* Work closely with security engineers, program managers, communications leads, and partner teams to understand the business and customer value of your software.
* Operate effectively across team and organizational boundaries; collaborate with adjacent teams in an inclusive and constructive manner when integrations, dependencies, or shared priorities arise.
* Balance customer requirements with team requirements; make effective priority tradeoffs between feature development and operational work.
* Communicate clearly and proactively about work in progress, technical decisions, blockers, and scope changes to all relevant stakeholders — both technical and non-technical.

Mentorship & Engineering Culture

* Actively mentor engineers on the team; provide substantive, constructive code review feedback to peers including more senior engineers.
* Train new team members on how the SecComms software is constructed, tested, operated, and secured — and how it fits into the broader Amazon Security architecture.
* Document what the team’s software does, how it is constructed, and how it connects to the bigger picture; keep documentation current as systems evolve.
* Seek feedback actively and early; incorporate feedback into designs and implementations to continuously raise the engineering bar.
* Evaluate and apply industry innovations — new tools, design patterns, and AWS capabilities — where they improve team outcomes.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Experience in one or more of the following domains: access- control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

title: Sr Software Development Engineer, ADC2S
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 12, 2026

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Software Development Engineer III to lead the architecture and technical direction for Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) control-plane services in air-gapped regions. This is a high-impact opportunity to define how government cloud infrastructure evolves, helping governments implement secure cloud solutions at scale.

In this role, you will serve as a technical leader within a team of engineers who build and operate software for EC2's control plane, fleet health, and capacity operations in air-gapped cloud environments. You will drive the architecture of the services and tooling that power these systems, shape how the team approaches complex trade-offs, and set the technical direction that enables the organization to deliver at scale. Because commercial tooling frequently does not exist in isolated regions, you will define what we build rather than what we configure, and you will drive the technical vision that guides those decisions.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Architect and define the technical direction for EC2 control-plane services, fleet health automation, and capacity tooling across air-gapped cloud environments, driving system design decisions that reduce blast radius and improve fleet reliability.
- Own end-to-end design of deployment pipelines and deployment orchestration for disconnected, isolated regions, including defining deployment strategies, monitoring standards, and incident response frameworks.
- Influence cross-team roadmaps and align multiple teams on shared infrastructure goals, data quality standards, and tooling strategy while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders across the air-gapped partition ecosystem.
- Mentor and develop engineers across the team, conduct design and code reviews, and raise the technical bar for the organization.
- Evaluate opportunities to integrate generative artificial intelligence tools and techniques to improve automation, code quality, and team productivity.

A day in the life
You might start the morning leading an architecture review for a new capacity orchestration system, then review a design document proposing a major change to how instance lifecycle events are processed in a disconnected region. After lunch, you meet with partner teams to align on a shared deployment pipeline, then spend the afternoon pairing with an engineer who is ramping on the control plane. As a technical leader, you set direction as much as you ship code. When engineers propose new approaches to automate capacity and remediation workflows, it is your role to evaluate those proposals, push them further, and make the call on where the team invests.

About the team
We own the software that keeps EC2 running in the air-gapped partitions: control-plane services, fleet-health automation, and the capacity tooling our government customers depend on. We operate what we build, so the engineers who design a remediation workflow are the ones it pages. Because the commercial tooling for a problem frequently does not exist in an isolated region, you build the thing rather than configure it. The team defaults to written design documents and clear ownership boundaries, and you will work alongside engineers who are passionate about solving hard infrastructure problems in the most demanding regulated cloud environments.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Transform
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building software that makes a meaningful difference for millions of customers? We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team of talented engineers in designing, building, and operating software systems at Amazon scale. In this role, you will own the technical vision and roadmap for your team's products, guiding your engineers through the full software lifecycle—from design and implementation to deployment and long-term maintenance. You will tackle ambiguous problems, define solutions that balance immediate needs with strategic goals, and create an environment where your team delivers high-quality, maintainable software. If you thrive on coaching engineers, shaping technical direction, and collaborating across teams to solve real customer problems, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow a high-performing software development team, providing coaching, mentorship, and career development guidance to engineers across multiple levels while building a strong talent pipeline through effective hiring practices.
- Own the technical strategy and 1–2 year product roadmap for your team's software systems, defining priorities that align with organizational goals and customer needs while making transparent tradeoffs on scope, resources, and timelines.
- Drive system design decisions across your team's architecture, ensuring solutions meet scalability, performance, security, and maintainability requirements while reducing complexity and technical debt over time.
- Collaborate with cross-functional partners—including product, program management, and peer engineering teams—to align on priorities, resolve dependencies, and deliver cohesive solutions that improve the customer experience.
- Establish operational excellence practices including metrics, audit mechanisms, and quality standards that enable your team to maintain healthy systems, respond effectively to issues, and continuously improve delivery processes.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing operational metrics and system health dashboards for the services your team owns. Mid-morning, you join a design review where your engineers walk through a proposed architecture, and you ask questions that sharpen the approach. After lunch, you have a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their career goals and map out a development plan. Later, you partner with a product manager to refine upcoming priorities and evaluate tradeoffs. You close the day by reviewing a narrative document a team member drafted, providing written feedback to strengthen the proposal before a broader leadership review.

title: Partner Solutions Architect, Partner Solutions Architects - France & Europe South
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping partners solve complex technical challenges and leveraging cloud computing technologies to drive innovation? Do you have a talent for explaining intricate application architectures and integration approaches to C-level stakeholders? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as a Senior Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) in France.

As a senior member of our Partner team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping and executing strategies to build mindshare and promote the broad adoption of AWS services across our Italian partner community. Your primary focus will be on owning the technical engagement with strategic system integrators and consulting partners in the Italian market, while influencing the broader Europe South partner ecosystem.

We're looking for a candidate who can demonstrate:

- Deep technical expertise in software architecture and cloud computing
- Strong customer-facing skills, ideally gained within a partner organization
- The ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges
- A track record of driving technical initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders (CIO, CTO, VP Engineering)
- Experience mentoring and raising the bar for technical teams


This role offers a high level of autonomy and great opportunities to learn and share best practices across countries. You'll be part of the France and Europe South team, collaborating with colleagues throughout the region.


Key job responsibilities
1. Act as a trusted technical advisor to our managed system integrators in France, supporting partner-led customer opportunities with architectural guidance and recommendations for successful engagements.

2. Champion AWS partners and assist solution providers in defining technical strategies to enhance their offerings on AWS — you should be as comfortable discussing cloud strategy with the CIO, TCO with the CFO, or continuous deployment with the DevOps team.

3. Drive partner technical maturity by guiding them to achieve AWS recognitions such as AWS Competencies, Service Deliveries, and Specializations.

4. Capture and share best practices with the broader Solution Architect community, contributing thought leadership and mentoring junior team members.

5. Evangelize AWS services and solutions to the Italian partner community through summits, workshops, product launches, and industry events.

6. Collaborate with internal teams (sales, partner managers, engineering) to ensure partner success and drive adoption of AWS services.

7. Contribute to the development of technical content, such as whitepapers, reference architectures, and solution briefs.

8. Participate in and lead complex technical discussions with partners and customers, proposing innovative solutions to business and technical challenges.

9. Influence the partner technical strategy at a regional level, contributing to cross-country initiatives and programs.

A day in the life
As a Senior Partner Solutions Architect, you'll engage in a diverse range of activities that showcase your technical expertise and business acumen. On any given day, you might:
- Engage in strategic discussions with partner executives, aligning on cloud adoption strategies and driving them toward AWS Competencies and advanced specializations.
- Apply the "working backwards from the customer" approach to support partners on their customer opportunities, designing innovative solutions that address complex business needs.
- Conduct enablement sessions and hands-on workshops with partners and their customers, upskilling them on the latest AWS innovations and best practices.
- Support a partner's customer opportunity providing deep-dive guidance on architecture best practices and addressing complex technical challenges.
- Mentor other solutions architects and contribute to team-wide knowledge sharing and skill development.
- Author technical content and deliver public speaking engagements at AWS, industry, or partner events.
- Some travel may be required (within France and occasionally across Europe South and France).

About the team
You'll join a dynamic, collaborative team of solutions architects dedicated to partner success across France and Europe South (Spain, Portugal, Italy). Our friendly, fun-loving environment fosters continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and growth opportunities regionally and at the EMEA level. Collaborating closely with AWS sales, partner, and engineering teams, we ensure partners have the technical support to build successful cloud businesses. Teamwork is paramount, engaging colleagues from diverse backgrounds to share best practices and explore innovative solutions together. We prioritize an enjoyable atmosphere where strong relationships thrive alongside professional development, achieving goals while having fun.

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a customer-facing, partner-facing, or consulting role within a technology company or system integrator
- Experience migrating or transforming enterprise workloads to the public cloud (AWS preferred)

title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

Basic qualifications

-3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
-2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
-Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

-3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
-Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Corporate Counsel, Litigation & Regulatory
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced litigation lawyer to join our India Legal team as Senior Corporate Counsel (SCC). In this role, the SCC will independently manage a large and diverse portfolio of contentious matters — spanning commercial arbitrations, civil suits, consumer disputes, and high-stakes regulatory and enforcement proceedings. You will be a trusted advisor to the business, driving litigation strategy, managing risk, and protecting the company's interests across a complex and fast-moving legal landscape.
This is a high-impact, high-ownership role suited to a self-starter who thrives in a dynamic environment, is comfortable handling matters of significant financial and reputational exposure and can balance strategic judgment with hands-on execution.


Key job responsibilities

• Litigation portfolio management: Independently manage a high volume of litigation matters end-to-end, including commercial arbitrations, civil and commercial suits, consumer disputes, and regulatory/enforcement actions.
• Strategy & risk assessment: Develop and drive case strategy, assess litigation risk and exposure, and advise business and leadership on potential outcomes, settlement options, and mitigation.
• External counsel management: Select, instruct, and manage external counsel and law firms; control legal spend, review strategy and work product, and ensure cost-effective, high-quality outcomes.
• Regulatory & enforcement matters: Lead responses to regulatory inquiries, investigations, notices, and enforcement proceedings; engage with regulators and authorities as appropriate.
• Stakeholder advisory: Partner with business teams, compliance, and cross-functional stakeholders to provide clear, practical, and actionable legal advice on contentious issues.
• Pre-litigation & dispute resolution: Handle pre-litigation disputes, demand/response notices, and negotiate settlements; explore and drive alternative dispute resolution where appropriate.
• Governance & reporting: Maintain accurate case tracking, prepare litigation reports and risk dashboards for leadership, and ensure timely escalation of material matters.
• Process & knowledge: Contribute to playbooks, standardization of litigation processes, and continuous improvement in how the team manages disputes at scale.

Basic qualifications

- 13+ years of litigation experience

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to work at the intersection of security, encryption and every internet-connected device in the world? We're looking for Software Development Engineers to build the services that help our customers secure their websites, APIs and devices with digital certificates that just work.

Our organization owns everything "certificates" for Amazon. That includes AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) for managing TLS and other X.509 certificates, AWS Private Certificate Authority (PCA) for private certificate issuance, and AWS Signer for code signing. Our services help customers create, manage, and deploy digital certificates based on strong cryptography and public-key infrastructure (PKI) best practices.

Certificate lifetimes are getting shorter and Post-Quantum cryptography is coming, while certificates now secure everything from IoT devices to AI agent workloads. Demand for content signing is growing as creators and publishers look for ways to prove their work is original. Customers need certificate management that runs without manual work at any scale. Certificates sit underneath almost every secure connection on the internet, so the systems you build here protect customer traffic across AWS.

We want engineers who question the status quo and push leadership and peers to do the right thing for the right reasons. Good ideas come from every level of the team, and we act on them.

You'll choose the right technology for the problem and learn AWS's distributed-systems and deployment-safety practices. If you don't know certificates or PKI yet, you'll learn them here.

Design, build, and operate distributed services where security and availability can't be compromised.

Take ambiguous requirements, clarify the problem with customers and partner teams, and deliver the simplest design that solves it.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Trainium Systems
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wondered what it takes to build the software systems that turn a rack of AI accelerators from inert silicon into a system a customer can run workloads on? Do you want deep ownership of a service that every one of those systems depends on to boot, run, and stay healthy?

Who are we?
Annapurna Labs is the part of Amazon that designs the custom silicon behind the cloud, including Trainium for AI training, Graviton CPUs, and the AWS Nitro system. Nearly every server in AWS runs hardware we designed. We build the chips, the systems, and the software that power some of the largest AI training and inference workloads in the world.

What do we do?
We build the software that provisions, operates, updates, and monitors the servers behind AWS's largest AI training workloads, built on Trainium, Graviton, and the AWS Nitro system. We give the people who run this hardware a complete way to stand it up, watch its health, deliver new software to it, and diagnose it, all through open, standard interfaces. We own that software from design through the running system.

Why it's high-impact?
The hardware is just silicon until our software makes it provisionable, observable, and serviceable. Every system runs through what we build. The service you own is on the path for all of them, and the people who run this hardware depend on it every day.

What's the challenge?
There are many ambiguous and difficult challenges in our fast-moving space. Our services require deep system and software expertise. You need to have the ability to work within a fast moving and startup-like environment in a large company. You will identify solutions, trying ideas, given space to fail and iterate to produce products that your customers love.

What you will do?
You will be part of a team that builds services end to end, from a blank page to an operator running it in production. You work backward from what the customer needs, build on the interfaces the hardware teams expose, and set the requirements those teams meet for you.

Who would succeed in this role?
A deeply technical engineer who stays close to both the customer and the system design. You dive deep to understand how the hardware and the software actually behave, you decide when a small change is enough and when a problem needs a new design, and you own your service without waiting to be told. You raise the bar in code reviews and you lift the engineers around you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own building provisioning services end to end that bring a server from power-on to ready-to-run.
- Build the services or interfaces for monitoring, health, and anomaly detection that surface a server's state and flag a failing component before it takes a workload down.
- Develop the software-delivery service that pushes an update to a running server, verifies it, and recovers the server cleanly when an update fails.
- Develop the diagnostics and troubleshooting tools that let an operator isolate a fault without pulling in the team that built the service.
- Define the standard interfaces an operator's tools drive, and set the behavior the hardware teams deliver against them, including plugins, libraries, tools, or APIs.
- Build the integrations with standard orchestration stacks.
- Develop and build the services that let an operator run a fleet of these servers at scale.

A day in the life
You design and build the provisioning and management surface over standard interfaces like Redfish, and the boot flow operator tools drive. You build the offline software-update service and prove the signed bundle applies and recovers cleanly. You design each system against the interfaces the platform exposes and turn architecture decisions into APIs and tools a customer runs without you in the loop.

About the team
Our team builds the software suite for provisioning, monitoring, software delivery, and the diagnostics of Trainium systems, and we build all of it on open, standard interfaces. We serve the engineers and operators who run large-scale AI training and need to provision, monitor, update, and troubleshoot it on their own terms. We own it end to end.

We're a small team with a large charter. You own real systems on day one. There are no layers between you and the problem. You build it, you ship it, you operate it, you improve it.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

title: Senior Transportation Quality Manager, ROC Quality Management
descriptionHtml:
ポジション概要 Position Overview
本ポジションは、新しいビジネスや特殊輸送が生み出す、前例のないミドルマイル（拠点間輸送）の配送品質課題を担うプログラムマネージャーの役割です。新規・特殊輸送で発生する輸送貨物の遅延に対し、品質を守る手法を自ら設計・実行し、プログラムとして確立していきます。確立された品質管理の方法論を土台にしつつも、その枠に捉われず、新しい輸送形態に適したミドルマイル品質マネジメントの手法をゼロから構築します。

This is a program manager role that owns the unprecedented Middle Mile (inter-facility transportation) delivery-quality challenges created by new businesses and special transportation. You will design and execute methods to protect quality against the transportation delays arising from new and special transportation, and establish them as a program. Building on established quality-management methodologies - but not bound by them - you will create, from the ground up, Middle Mile quality-management methods suited to new transportation modes.

チーム概要 Team overview
JP ATS ROC - Quality Management (QM) は、Middle Mile（拠点間輸送）における配送品質を守る ROC（Relay Operations Center）内のチームです。我々のミッションは「お客様への約束（Promise：配送予定日）を守り抜く」こと。確立された方法論を持つ一方で、新しいビジネスや特殊輸送といった前例のない領域にも果敢に挑み、既存の枠に捉われずに品質マネジメントの手法を進化させ続けています。データとメトリクスを基盤に、オペレーション・輸送・リーダーシップをつなぐハブとして機能します。


JP ATS ROC - Quality Management (QM) is the team within the ROC (Relay Operations Center) that safeguards delivery quality across the Middle Mile (inter-facility transportation). Our mission is to keep the Promise (promised delivery date) we make to customers. While we hold established methodologies, we also boldly take on uncharted areas such as new businesses and special transportation, continuously evolving our quality-management methods beyond conventional frames. Grounded in data and metrics, we serve as the hub connecting Operations, Transportation, and Leadership.

職務内容 Job Description
担当は、新しいビジネス・特殊輸送で発生するミドルマイルの輸送遅延・品質課題です。これらの原因を分析し、既存の品質管理手法が通用するか否かを見極めたうえで、必要に応じて新しい輸送形態に適した方法論を構築・実行します。Transportation / Capacity Planning や FC / Sort Center / Delivery Station のオペレーションと連携し、現場実態に即した実行可能なプログラムへと落とし込みます。あわせて、配送予定日の精度の維持・改善や、対応プロセスの標準化・プログラム化を推進し、再現性とスケーラビリティを確保します。


You will own the Middle Mile transportation delays and quality issues arising from new businesses and special transportation. You will analyze their root causes, assess whether existing quality-management methods apply, and - where needed - build and execute methodologies suited to new transportation modes. Partnering with Transportation / Capacity Planning and FC / Sort Center / Delivery Station operations, you will translate these into executable programs grounded in on-the-ground realities. You will also drive the maintenance and improvement of delivery-date accuracy and the standardization and productization of the response process to ensure repeatability and scalability.

本ポジションの魅力 Why This Role Is Attractive
- 前例のない領域で、ミドルマイル品質の方法論を自ら設計・確立できるオーナーシップとやりがい

- 既存の手法を活用しつつ、新規・特殊輸送に最適化した新しいアプローチを構築できる大きな裁量

- リーダーシップ／経営層と直接連携し、戦略を全国規模の成果に変える影響力

- 成長領域を担うことで得られる、高い可視性とキャリア拡大の機会

- 配属直後ではないものの、将来的にはPeople Managerとしてチームを率いるキャリアパス


- The ownership and reward of designing and establishing Middle Mile quality methodologies in uncharted territory

- Significant latitude to leverage existing methods while building new approaches optimized for new and special transportation

- Direct influence with leadership, turning strategy into nationwide results

- High visibility and strong opportunities to expand your career by owning a growth area

- A career path toward leading a team as a People Manager in the future (not immediately upon joining)


At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.




Key job responsibilities
- 新しいビジネス・特殊輸送で発生するミドルマイルの輸送遅延・品質課題を担当し、その原因分析と改善をリードする

- 確立された品質管理の方法論を活用しつつ、その枠に捉われず、新しい輸送形態に適したミドルマイル品質マネジメントの手法を構築・実行する

- 配送予定日の精度（納期遵守）の維持・改善をリードする

- Transportation / Capacity Planning と連携し、輸送キャパシティの制約を踏まえた品質・配送予定日の設計を行う

- FC / Sort Center / Delivery Station のオペレーションと連携し、現場実態に即した実行可能なプログラムを展開する

- 対応プロセスを標準化・プログラム化し、再現性とスケーラビリティを確保する

- リーダーシップ／経営層に対し、戦略・進捗・成果をデータに基づき明確にコミュニケーションする

(English)
- Own the Middle Mile transportation delays and quality issues arising from new businesses and special transportation, and lead their root-cause analysis and improvement

- Leverage established quality-management methodologies while, unbound by their conventional frame, building and executing Middle Mile quality-management methods suited to new transportation modes

- Lead the maintenance and improvement of delivery-date accuracy (on-time delivery)

- Partner with Transportation / Capacity Planning to design quality and promised-delivery-date logic that reflects transportation capacity constraints

- Work with FC / Sort Center / Delivery Station operations to deploy executable programs grounded in on-the-ground realities

- Standardize and productize the response process to ensure repeatability and scalability

- Communicate strategy, progress, and results clearly and with data to leadership

A day in the life
1日の流れ
午前中は、各種メトリクスをもとにした分析業務が中心です。担当するミドルマイルの輸送遅延・品質課題の動向をデータから読み解き、課題の所在や改善の仮説を整理します。午後は、その分析結果をもとに関係者との協議・連携を行い、現場で実行可能な打ち手へと落とし込みます。
また、月に1回程度は実際の現場に足を運び、見学・観察を通じて得られたインサイトから品質向上の糸口を探ります。データ上では見えにくい実態を把握し、データと実オペレーションを紐づけることで、より精度の高い課題解決につなげます。

Mornings center on analysis work driven by various metrics. You read the trends of the Middle Mile transportation delays and quality issues you own from the data, and organize where the problems lie and your hypotheses for improvement. In the afternoon, based on those analyses, you hold discussions and collaborate with stakeholders - such as Transportation / Capacity Planning and FC / Sort Center / Delivery Station operations - to translate them into actions that can be executed on the ground.

In addition, roughly once a month you visit actual sites, seeking clues for quality improvement from the insights gained through observation and firsthand study. By grasping the realities that are hard to see in the data alone and connecting data with actual operations, you drive more accurate problem-solving.

フレックスタイム制 Flex time
コアタイム無し・実働8時間/日となりますが、業務時間帯はマネージャーと相談の上、業務および個人の都合に応じて勤務時間帯の調整ができ、ワークライフハーモニーを重視した働き方が可能です。 No core hours, with 8 working hours per day. Working hours can be adjusted in consultation with your manager based on business needs and personal circumstances, enabling a work style that prioritizes work-life harmony.


働き方 Work Style
原則：週5日東京へ出社 Standard: 5 days per week in the Tokyo office.


勤務地 Work Location
東京（東京都品川区） Tokyo (Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo)

About the team

title: Senior Robotics Data Engineer, Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR)
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in solving the most critical operations problem behind cutting-edge robotics development? Interested in fast dynamic environment? Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR) team is building advanced robotic systems through frontier foundation models, and high-quality data collection is a core input to that research.


Key job responsibilities
Own the technical execution and continuous improvement of early-stage data collection for advanced robotics. Partner with researchers to translate research objectives into reliable collection workflows, improve data quality, and shorten policy training iteration cycles. Work independently within agreed priorities, providing hands-on technical guidance to data collectors and coordinating execution across research, engineering, and operations.

In this role, you will
- Own end-to-end collection iterations for assigned research tasks, from requirements and station readiness through pilot collection, quality review, and delivery of training-ready data. Coordinate dependencies and resolve blockers to meet agreed quality and turnaround goals.
- Partner with researchers to develop and refine SOPs, translating task objectives, failure modes, and evaluation feedback into clear collection instructions and acceptance criteria. Maintain version control and ensure collectors adopt changes consistently.
- Serve as the technical subject matter expert for assigned collection workflows, equipment, and tools. Independently diagnose complex issues involving robotics hardware, sensors, calibration, collection software, and data integrity; engage engineering partners when resolution requires deeper expertise.
- Provide critical technical direction and coaching to data collectors. Demonstrate correct execution, calibrate collectors against quality standards, and develop their troubleshooting skills and judgment.
- Assess operational and technical risks, including equipment readiness, unsafe conditions, data loss, and quality degradation. Determine when to continue, pause collection, or escalate, and coordinate recovery within established safety and technical boundaries.
- Own collection performance metrics, including usable-data yield, rework, station availability, and iteration turnaround time. Use dashboards and root-cause analysis to identify recurring issues and verify that corrective actions improve results.
- Lead operational improvement projects that reduce collection failures and iteration delays. Develop and implement reusable workflows, troubleshooting guides, readiness checks, and lightweight tooling, and drive adoption across relevant stations, shifts, and partner teams.
- Coordinate technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including researchers, engineering, operations, and annotation partners. Communicate priorities, trade-offs, risks, and decisions clearly, and escalate issues that threaten delivery commitments.

Basic qualifications

- Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
- Bachelor's degree or above in Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or related field, or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Experience diagnosing hardware, software, or process issues, using evidence to identify root causes and implement corrective actions
- Strong problem-solving and systems-thinking skills, including the ability to assess risks and make sound technical decisions with incomplete information
- Working understanding of how collection quality, task coverage, and consistency affect model training and evaluation, with the ability to translate research requirements into executable procedures and quality checks
- Demonstrated ability to train and mentor others and communicate complex information clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, including remote teams and colleagues who use English as a second language
- Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and dependencies across multiple collection tasks

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in technical operations, engineering, technical project management, or a related role involving hands-on ownership of complex systems or workflows
- Experience developing SOPs, technical documentation, performance metrics, and process improvements, and ensuring their adoption
- Experience with robotics, teleoperation, egocentric video, or multimodal sensor data
- Experience supporting ML/AI data collection, annotation, quality assurance, or model evaluation workflows
- Familiarity with sensor calibration, timestamp synchronization, pose tracking, and data integrity checks
- Experience using vibe coding agents to build and maintain lightweight operational tools
- Experience taking an experimental workflow from initial pilot through repeatable execution across multiple stations or teams

title: Lead Embedded & Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Sr. Embedded & Digital Control Engineer to lead the DSP/FPGA control architecture and embedded implementation strategy for the SST, coordinating hierarchical control loops and HW/SW co-design.

As a Sr. Embedded & Digital Control Engineer you will define the DSP/FPGA hierarchical control architecture — fast inner loops through supervisory control — where the structure must be established, not inherited. You will own real-time implementation constraints across power, FPGA and embedded layers and integrate control onto the target platform at system scale. You will drive stability/transient/dynamic-load validation and fault-state integration, and mentor control and firmware engineers across the program.




Key job responsibilities
Control architecture:
- Define DSP/FPGA architecture for hierarchical converter control.
- Coordinate fast inner loops, supervisory control and system-level control functions.
- Define control interfaces to power stages, sensors, protection and communications.

HW/SW co-design:
- Coordinate power-electronics, FPGA and embedded-software interfaces.
- Ensure real-time implementation constraints are reflected in control architecture.
- Lead integration of control algorithms into the target hardware platform.

System validation:
- Support stability, transient-response and dynamic-load validation.
- Coordinate control tuning and troubleshooting with Power Electronics and Simulation.
- Support fault-state and protection integration.

SST System Alignment:
- Lead the system-aligned state machine and system behavior implementation, including OFF, Standby, Precharged, ON, Fault and Warning states.
- Coordinate VRT/FRT, MVAC load acceptance/rejection, ESS power sharing, LVDC regulation, redundancy and recovery behavior.
- Define telemetry and control interfaces required for Modbus TCP/IP and the broader data-center operational interface.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll focus on architecting the digital signal processing and FPGA control systems that manage power conversion and distribution across our data centers. You'll start your day reviewing control performance data and collaborating with power electronics and firmware teams to refine real-time implementations. You might spend time defining control interfaces between sensors, protection systems, and communications protocols, then shift to validating system behavior under dynamic load conditions.

You'll also mentor other control and firmware engineers, sharing your expertise in hierarchical control design and helping them navigate implementation challenges. Your work spans from theoretical control architecture decisions to hands-on troubleshooting of transient responses and fault-state behaviors on actual hardware platforms.

About the team
We are the team that keeps AWS infrastructure running reliably across the globe. Our mission is to design, plan, deliver, and operate the systems that power every AWS data center—managing thousands of variables across power, cooling, networking, and storage to ensure our customers have continuous access to the services they depend on. We're building next-generation power systems that require innovative control strategies, and we're looking for someone who can help us establish new standards in this space. You'll work alongside power electronics specialists, embedded software engineers, and systems architects who are committed to solving complex technical challenges. Together, we're shaping the future of how data centers manage and distribute power efficiently and reliably.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to celebrate our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related experience/ field.
- Experience with hierarchical control architectures.
- Experience leading cross-functional control/HW/SW integration delivery.
- Experience documenting design decisions, assumptions, trade-offs, risks and technical specifications.
- Experience using engineering analysis and measured evidence to drive decisions.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Model Customization and Optimization), AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you embed directly with strategic customers to build, optimize, and run custom generative AI models in production alongside their engineering teams. You own complete model workstreams end-to-end from defining the evaluation bar and preparing data, through training and inference optimization, to production deployment.

FDE IIs on this team works at the intersection of models and systems. They customize state-of-the-art open-weight and foundation models for new domains, languages, and modalities; migrate and optimize training and inference workloads on AWS Trainium and operate those models as production services. They are autonomous contributors who take on projects where the business goal is clear, but the path is not. They make design trade-offs with appropriate guidance, limit short-term workarounds, coach others on producing high-quality code, and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer ML and engineering teams: Understand the customer's business, data, model stack, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous goals into a measurable evaluation bar and a technical plan for your workstream such as model selection, customization approach, and serving architecture. Requires up to 25% travel.

Customize and post-train models. Adapt open-weight and foundation models to customer domains through continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning (including RLHF, RL with verifiable rewards, and multi-turn agentic RL). Build the data pipelines, synthetic data generation, and evaluation harnesses that prove a customized model out performs the baseline on the customer's own quality, latency, and cost bar. Apply these techniques to high-value patterns such as coding agents, domain foundation models, and multi-adapter serving.

Build large-scale training and inference systems. Design and implement distributed training and RL post-training pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron-LM, Miles, and verl. Build RL interaction harnesses using NeMo Gym or OpenEnv to connect agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions to training. Develop production inference stacks with engines such as SGLang and vLLM, and optimize throughput, latency, memory footprint, and cost per token through quantization, parallelism, speculative decoding, and batching.

Optimize models on AWS chips. Migrate and tune training and inference workloads for AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Profile performance, close accuracy-parity gaps against GPU baselines, and develop custom kernels where needed. Benchmark rigorously and turn results into decisions customers can act on.

Accelerate impact beyond the engagement. Codify reusable fine-tuning recipes, evaluation frameworks, benchmarking tools, and optimization patterns that accelerate future deployments. Feed field learnings back to AWS service teams, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and AWS Neuron. Identify opportunities to expand model customization and optimization within your customer engagement.


About the team
ABOUT AWS:
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Team
The Custom Model and Optimization team, part of the Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with enterprises, AI-native startups, and foundation model providers to build, customize, and optimize generative AI models at scale. Our work spans domain foundation models, post-training of open-weight models, and moving training and inference workloads onto AWS Trainium. As embedded engineers within the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering motion, we bring deep model and optimization expertise to customers' most strategic AI workloads, and we turn what we learn into tooling and patterns that scale across AWS.

- Hands-on experience with generative AI technology, such as LLMs, vision-language models, or speech models

title: Applied Scientist, Automated Reasoning Group
descriptionHtml:
This is an Applied Scientist position in the AWS Automated Reasoning group. In this role you will work together with leading scientists in the field to develop and apply the latest automated-reasoning techniques, formal methods, and neurosymbolic approaches to ensure safety, security, and correctness of code and services. As Agentic AI becomes the primary method of software development, we are changing the way that computer systems are developed and operated, raising the bar on quality, verifiability, and durability.

Automated Reasoning at Amazon is central to maintaining customer trust and improving the customer experience. Automated Reasoning techniques are being applied in diverse areas spanning generative-AI safety, agentic sandboxes, cloud infrastructure verification, software security and verification, cryptographic assurance, and policy validation. The techniques we are applying include automated theorem proving, model checking, constraint solving, and neurosymbolic proof search.

This is a unique opportunity to get in early on a rapidly expanding part of AWS and help shape the technology, product, and business. You will have a chance to utilize your deep technical expertise within a fast-paced environment and make a large business and customer impact.


Key job responsibilities
• Design and implement algorithms and formal methods for automated reasoning, including constraint solving, model checking, static analysis, theorem proving, and program synthesis to verify the correctness, security, and reliability of computing systems.
• Solve large or significantly complex problems that require deep knowledge and scientific innovation in your domain; own strategic problem solving and take the lead on design, implementation, and delivery of solutions with long-term quantifiable impact.
• Develop new decision procedures, heuristics, and search strategies that improve the scalability and accuracy of verification tools; build and deploy production-grade automated reasoning systems at Amazon scale.
• Explore and apply generative AI and machine learning techniques to enhance automated reasoning capabilities, including learning-based heuristics for search and optimization, neural approaches to symbolic reasoning, and methods for verifying the correctness of AI-generated code.
• Develop automated reasoning techniques for generative AI and agentic coding systems, including methods for ensuring the safety and alignment of autonomous software agents and applying formal guarantees to large language model outputs.
• Conduct original research and publish findings in peer-reviewed venues.
• Work with customer teams to understand the nature of their software and the properties they need to establish; identify tools and methods capable of addressing verification needs, including novel analysis capabilities.
• Provide cross-organizational technical influence, increasing productivity and effectiveness by sharing deep knowledge and experience; collaborate with partner teams to translate verification capabilities into production systems.
• Mentor scientists and engineers on formal methods, neurosymbolic techniques, and best practices for building reliable automated reasoning systems; assist in career development of others.

Basic qualifications

- PhD or equivalent research experience
- Experience in any of the following areas: mathematical logic, formal verification, satisfiability solving (eg SAT/SMT), mechanical theorem proving, model checking, or program analysis

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in professional software development
- Experience programming in OCaml, Haskell, Rust, Scala, Kotlin, or a related language
- Experience with proof assistants or verification languages such as Lean, Verus, Dafny, Isabelle, or Rocq
- Experience applying formal methods or automated reasoning to real-world software, security, or systems problems

title: Senior Product Manager, Serverless Compute
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Serverless Compute team. Our team owns the products that make it radically easier for builders to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent cloud applications without managing infrastructure. Our portfolio includes some of the most widely adopted services in cloud computing: AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, Amazon EventBridge, and AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Together, these services power millions of customer workloads, from event-driven architectures and workflow orchestration to full application deployment. Our latest innovations are defining how customers build complex, multi-step, AI-native applications on AWS, including durable execution for AI agents and next-generation compute primitives.

We're looking for a product manager who is passionate about solving customer problems and has demonstrated success in turning ambiguous customer needs into successful products. In this role, you will help evolve our serverless services by delivering new capabilities and intuitive developer experiences that make it easier to build applications without becoming an expert in distributed systems. If you're excited by cloud computing and have a deep-rooted passion for the evolution of computing and application development platforms, we want to talk to you.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be a critical part of the PM organization that owns the business model and P&L, prioritization of the product roadmap, customer segmentation and pricing, and demand generation for impactful new products. You will work across engineering, business development, and marketing leads to set strategy, define the product, and make high-judgment trade-offs between features and time-to-market. You will partner with technical leaders to ensure the programming model, scalability and reliability promises, and developer experience delight our customers. You will also play a key role in hiring additional team members and helping set the vision and culture of this business.

The breadth of this role is what makes it unique. Depending on your interests and strengths, you could find yourself working on event-driven architectures that connect and integrate cloud-native systems at scale, workflow orchestration and durable execution for AI agents and distributed applications, or developer experiences that make building, deploying, and governing serverless applications effortless.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and prioritize the product roadmap for your service area, translating customer needs into clear requirements and making transparent trade-offs between scope, quality, and delivery timelines.
- Drive product development end-to-end across engineering, operations, business development, and marketing — from authoring business requirements and functional specifications through design, implementation, and launch.
- Engage directly with external customers and partners to understand their technical challenges, validate assumptions through usability studies and market research, and turn those insights into product decisions that improve adoption and satisfaction.
- Evaluate industry innovations, technology platforms, and generative AI capabilities to identify opportunities that strengthen our serverless portfolio and keep it ahead of customer expectations.
- Mentor and coach other product managers on best practices while actively participating in recruiting efforts to grow the team.

A day in the life
Your morning might start by reviewing service metrics and customer feedback to identify emerging patterns, then shifting into a design review with engineers where you weigh architectural trade-offs for an upcoming feature. After lunch you could be running a customer call to validate a new API design, followed by a working session with marketing to refine messaging for an upcoming launch. You'll balance focused solo time such as writing product requirements, analyzing competitive data, and refining your roadmap with collaborative sessions that keep engineering, design, and business teams aligned on what to build next.

About the team
We are a core part of the AWS Serverless Compute organization with team members in Vancouver, Seattle, and Dublin. Together, we work as one team spanning Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, and Elastic Beanstalk. Our shared mission is to make it radically easier for developers to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent cloud applications without managing infrastructure.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we are building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, document reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and take on more complex challenges over time.

- 5+ years of technical product management with internet business experience
- 5+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience

title: Data Center Design Manager, Data Center Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
You'll join a diverse team of data center professionals. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. You will own the design direction, design quality, and design delivery for a portfolio of mission-critical data center projects across the APAC region.

This is a deeply design-centric role. You will set the vision for complex, multi-discipline infrastructure systems driving design from concept through detailed engineering, construction documentation, and commissioning validation. You will define and evolve regional design standards, champion design automation and tooling innovation, and embed continuous improvement into every phase of the design lifecycle. Your decisions will directly shape how AWS builds its next generation of data centers in APAC.

This role demands close collaboration across multiple facets of the AWS design engineering organisation, external engineering consultancies, and regulatory bodies.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Leading a multidisciplinary team of engineers through all phases of data center critical infrastructure design from concept through detailed engineering, construction documentation, and commissioning validation.

Owning end-to-end design direction for power, cooling, controls, physical security, and structural systems setting the architectural vision and ensuring designs meet AWS performance, reliability, and cost targets.

Establishing regional design standards, basis-of-design documents, and design quality frameworks that drive consistency and scalability across APAC projects.

Leading design reviews from schematic through 100% construction documentation, ensuring technical rigour, code compliance, and alignment with AWS global design principles.

A day in the life
As a Design Manager, your day is anchored in design. You might start with a technical design review of a new cooling topology, then shift to a cross-discipline coordination meeting resolving interface clashes between electrical and mechanical systems.

After lunch, you're reviewing design automation outputs, benchmarking design cycle metrics against regional targets, and coaching a design engineer on construction documentation standards. Every day, you're shaping how AWS designs and delivers its most critical infrastructure in APAC.

title: Electrical Assembly, Integration, & Testing Engineer, Cryogenic Hardware, Quantum Computing
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) team is looking to hire an Electrical Assembly & Testing Engineer. This role builds, tests, and calibrates delicate electronic components for cryogenic quantum computing systems. Candidates must have experience in precision electronics assembly, microelectronics integration, surface-mount (SMT) soldering and rework, and basic DC/RF measurements. The candidate will work with cryogenic RF/microwave systems, quantum processor electronics, and precision electrical test equipment. Responsibilities include precision soldering, rework, and assembly of PCBs populated with fine-pitch SMT components and RF connectors, as well as cable assemblies for cryogenic systems, following technical drawings while adhering to strict ESD and cleanliness protocols. The ideal candidate should have excellent fine motor skills, familiarity with basic electrical engineering principles, and strong problem solving and communication abilities. Working effectively within a team environment is critical.

Key job responsibilities
The primary responsibility of this role is precision electrical assembly and integration for cryogenic quantum computing operations. You will assemble, integrate, and package electro-mechanical components including PCB assemblies, cable assemblies, and quantum processors using specialized tools. You will perform high-quality hand soldering including connector attachment, SMT reflow, PCB rework, and assembly/routing of DC/RF harnesses/cables. Much of this work is done under a microscope: placing, reflowing, and reworking small SMT packages and miniature RF connectors, and inspecting the result against IPC workmanship standards. You will conduct electrical tests using multimeters, Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), and automated test equipment to verify assembly performance through continuity, isolation, and transmission measurements. You will assemble components designed for high vacuum and cryogenic environments. You will follow detailed work instructions, update build logs, generate and update assembly procedures, inspect outside vendor assembly work, and maintain strict electrostatic discharge (ESD) safety protocols.

A day in the life
You will work across teams to assemble, integrate, test, and validate electrical systems for cryogenic quantum computing hardware. A typical week mixes bench work at the microscope, such as populating or reworking SMT components on cryogenic PCBs, with harness and cable fabrication, DC and RF testing, and documentation. You will read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical procedures to execute precision assembly tasks. You will coordinate with stakeholders on electrical integration requirements, documentation, and scheduling. You will wire up qubit control electronic racks and contribute to developing new electrical assembly procedures while maintaining rigorous quality standards. The ideal candidate should embrace a fast-paced startup environment: they must be able to learn quickly, operate independently, communicate clearly, and consistently demonstrate reliability.

About the team
The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is a multi-disciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and technicians, on a mission to develop a fault-tolerant quantum computer.

- Knowledge of material and manufacturing methods

- Experience with analog, digital, and high-speed circuit design
