title: Software Dev Engineer II, NASC Tech
descriptionHtml:
What if you could build intelligent systems that shape how millions of packages move through Amazon's transportation network every day?

North American Sort Centers (NASC) are a critical part of Amazon's Middle Mile transportation network, connecting fulfillment centers with the last-mile delivery network. NASC Tech is building the next generation of AI-powered planning and execution platforms that drive labor, capacity, and network connectivity decisions across hundreds of Sort Centers. We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to help shape the technical direction of platforms that connect long-term strategic planning, mid-term optimization, and short-term operational execution into a unified ecosystem. Our vision is to move beyond disconnected planning tools and manual decision-making toward intelligent, event-driven systems where changes in network demand, capacity, or labor requirements can automatically trigger downstream model execution, planning adjustments, and operational actions. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of distributed systems, Applied Science, and Agentic AI. You will design scalable model orchestration platforms, integrate ML models into production workflows, and build agentic systems that leverage LLMs, MCP, and tool-based integrations to connect data, and operational systems. As an SDE II in this team, you will own complex technical problems end-to-end, influence architecture and engineering decisions, and partner closely with Product, Applied Science, Data Engineering, and Operations teams across Amazon. If you enjoy building new systems, solving challenging engineering problems at scale, and turning emerging AI capabilities into practical solutions with measurable business impact, this role offers an opportunity to help define the future of Middle Mile planning technology.

Key job responsibilities
The position focuses on building scalable planning and execution platforms across multiple planning horizons within Sort cneters. You will partner closely with Product, Science, Site Operations, and cross-organizational teams including AFT and Sort Tech to develop intelligent systems that connects planning systems and operational execution. This includes building agentic systems, model orchestration frameworks, and AI-powered automation to streamline complex workflows and enable data-driven decision-making.

In addition, you will:

- Design and build scalable distributed systems and full-stack applications that solve complex operational challenges at Amazon scale.
- Architect and develop intelligent automation solutions that integrate AI capabilities, science models, and enterprise systems.
- Build reliable platforms for executing, orchestrating, and monitoring ML and optimization models in production.
- Lead end-to-end technical design and delivery, translating broadly defined business problems into scalable, extensible solutions.
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to influence architectural decisions and drive innovation.
- Drive engineering best practices, ensuring high standards for software quality, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.
- Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing while contributing to the team's technical direction.
- Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software with strong end-to-end ownership.

A day in the life
As an engineer on our team, your day could involve designing an event-driven workflow that automatically re-evaluates labor and capacity plans when network demand changes, building agents that connects planning data with ML models to generate actionable recommendations, or scaling distributed orchestration platforms that executes hundreds of optimization and simulation workflows across the Sort Center network. You will work closely with Scientists to host new models, collaborate with Product and Operations teams to understand real-world planning challenges, and partner with engineers across Amazon to integrate systems that have traditionally operated independently. Some days will focus on architecture and technical design, while others will involve hands-on development, experimentation with emerging AI technologies, reviewing code, or improving the reliability and performance of production systems. You will have the autonomy to influence technical decisions, take ownership of meaningful projects, and see your work translate directly into operational improvements across Amazon's Middle Mile network. Our environment encourages engineers to experiment, challenge existing approaches, and build solutions that balance innovation with operational excellence.

About the team
Out team builds and operates platforms that power planning and operational decision-making across Amazon's Sort Center network. This charter spans long-term strategic planning, mid-term optimization, and short-term execution, connecting science-driven recommendations with systems that turn plans into operational actions. The engineering ecosystem includes full-stack applications, distributed model execution platforms, data processing pipelines, and decision automation services, built on AWS technologies including ECS, AWS Batch, SageMaker, Lambda, Step Functions, Aurora DB and DynamoDB. We are evolving these platforms into an intelligent, connected ecosystem through event-driven orchestration and agentic systems. Our teams collaborate to integrate AI agents, APIs, knowledge bases, and data tools on a shared AI infrastructure backbone, enabling intelligent automation, actionable insights, and seamless workflows across organizational boundaries. With a rapidly expanding charter spanning planning, execution, and AI-powered automation, this is an opportunity to build new capabilities from the ground up, shape foundational architectures, and influence how Amazon's Middle Mile operates at scale.

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

descriptionHtml:
Amazon runs one of the world’s most complex eCommerce platforms, where operational efficiency directly drives profitability and customer satisfaction. Efficiency is core to Amazon’s DNA, reflected in the Leadership Principle of Frugality and the Flywheel strategy that lowers cost structures to fuel growth. With the cost of operating Amazon’s global infrastructure measured in billions of dollars, achieving true economies of scale rather than allowing scale to increase costs is essential to our success.

The Alloy team serves as Amazon’s central efficiency organization, leading company-wide cost optimization through intelligent and automated use of AWS resources. Our work spans thousands of internal services, enabling large-scale efficiency improvements with minimal engineering effort from partner teams. We drive optimization across multiple layers of Amazon’s stack, focusing on GPU efficiency infrastructure for AI/ML workloads through centralized scheduling, software performance profiling, and end-to-end storage optimizations through data lifecycle management. These cross-cutting initiatives transform isolated team optimizations into scalable, safe, and reusable systems that continuously improve efficiency across Amazon.

As a Software Development Engineer in Alloy, you will collaborate with service and infrastructure teams across Amazon to identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks in large-scale distributed systems. You will design and build mechanisms to measure, analyze, and automate performance improvements, using data to set and drive company-wide efficiency goals. You will work closely with Principal and Distinguished Engineers, gaining exposure to Amazon’s most advanced systems while developing deep technical expertise and leadership skills. Your work will directly influence how Amazon’s software and services operate at scale, delivering measurable cost savings in the tens to hundreds of millions of dollars each year and advancing Amazon’s commitment to operational excellence and sustainability.

In this role, you will:
- Solve performance and efficiency problems that manifest at scale.
- Design metrics and measure performance and cost efficiency of services in Amazon's ecosystem.
- Collaborate with service teams to identify inefficiencies, and design and implement solutions.

title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- 2+ year work experience in Business Process Outsourcing in any of the following domains: accounting, regulatory compliance, IT services, quality assurance
- Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in trade compliance, import/export operations, customs regulations, cross-border logistics, or regulatory compliance processes related to global trade operations is preferred
- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management / FMCG company / Corporate role
- Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
- Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
- Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help millions of customers in Latin America get fair, simple and transparent credit? Amazon's 1P Lending team is looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive our lending programs in Brazil and Mexico.

You will own complex, cross-team programs that bring Amazon's own lending products to market and help them grow. These programs cover customer onboarding, credit decisioning, loan servicing, repayments, and integration with local partners and regulators. You will be the connection between engineering teams in São Paulo and India and business partners in Brazil and Mexico, turning ambiguous goals into clear plans and launches.

This role sits where technology, financial products and regulation meet. You'll work with Engineering, Product, Risk, Finance, Legal and Compliance to keep large initiatives on track, move fast where it's safe, and make sure every launch meets the bar that financial services require.

We're looking for a technically strong, high-ownership program leader. You should be able to understand system architecture, ask the right questions of engineers, spot risks early, and drive results across countries and time zones.

Key job responsibilities
Own programs from start to finish: Plan and run lending programs for Brazil and Mexico, from defining requirements through launch and post-launch review.
Work across geographies: Coordinate engineering teams in São Paulo and India and business partners in Brazil and Mexico. Align roadmaps, dependencies and timelines across time zones.
Bring technical depth: Work with engineers and SDMs on system design, integration plans and technical trade-offs. Find architectural risks and dependencies before they become blockers.
Turn regulation into delivery: Partner with Legal, Compliance and Risk to turn local regulatory requirements (for example from BACEN and CNBV) into technical plans, deliverables and audit-ready launches.
Manage risks and dependencies: Proactively find, track and reduce risks across teams. Escalate clearly and early, and push decisions forward in ambiguous situations.
Set up ways of working: Create and improve the planning, release, launch-readiness and reporting processes the team uses to deliver at scale.
Communicate with leaders: Write clear status updates, narratives and business reviews for senior leaders. Give honest views on progress, risks and trade-offs.
Keep improving operations: Drive programs that improve system reliability, security, compliance and the customer experience after launch.

A day in the life
On a given day you might:

Run a launch-readiness review for a new credit product in Mexico.
Sync with engineering teams in India on a shared dependency.
Work with Legal and Compliance to scope a new regulatory requirement in Brazil.
Review a design doc with an SDM to understand the trade-offs and their impact on the timeline.
Write a status narrative for senior leaders.
You'll split your time between technical program execution, working with stakeholders and improving how the team delivers.

title: Systems Development Engineer, Files, Edge, and Data Streams (FEDS)
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 13, 2026

The Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC), AWS for Government, Storage Services team is hiring a Systems Development Engineer to join the team. This is an exciting opportunity to use the latest cloud computing technologies to help U.S. Government agencies implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve technical problems.

In this role, you will join a team of highly talented engineers building and operating Amazon Simple Queue and Notification Services, Kinesis Data Streams (KDS), and AWS Managed Flink and Kafka, services instrumental to some of our customers’ most sensitive workflows. This is a great opportunity to have direct impact to some of the largest-scaled systems in the world and work with some of the smartest people in the industry, while having a huge impact.

A successful Systems Development Engineer should be focused on troubleshooting complex system operations, not just on a server level but enterprise wide. Additionally, you will take part and be responsible for developing and building exciting new features for these services - further enabling our customers’ mission. You should also have a solid foundation in multiple operating systems, networking and general knowledge of cloud services. You will work with Amazon's largest and most demanding customers to address specific needs across a full suite of services. You will dive deep into technical issues and work diligently to improve the customer experience.

The candidate selected must be a U.S. citizen. Upon start, the selected candidate must obtain and maintain a TS/SCI with Polygraph security clearance and will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” On a “typical” day engineers might deep dive to root cause a customer issue, investigate why a metric is trending the wrong way, consult with the top engineers at Amazon, or discuss radical new approaches to automate operational issues.

You'll be part of a world-class team in a fast-paced environment that has the entrepreneurial feel of a start-up. This is an opportunity to operate and engineer systems on a massive scale, and to gain top-notch experience in cloud computing. You'll be surrounded by people who are smart, passionate about cloud computing, and believe that world class service is critical to customer success. You'll become a master at distributed systems troubleshooting, response, measurement, and automation. You will design and build the operational scalability that sustains the platform's insane growth. You will be able to measure your success by its visible impact on the efficiency and effectiveness of government services for our nation.

A day in the life
Every day is Day 1 at Amazon. On a typical day, our Systems Development Engineers will support AWS Storage and Data services engineering and operations by completing activities including but not limited to:
- Region and feature builds
- Manage and monitoring systems health and status
- Provisioning devices, assisting with data ingestion, and device cleaning
- Troubleshooting device, network, and/or configuration related issues
- Identifying, documenting, and communicating engineering and operations recommendations to team members
- Writing and disseminating after action reports capturing key events, actions taken, and future mitigation plans
- Providing on-call support when necessary

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
 
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
 
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
 
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
 
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

- Associate's degree or above, or CND (Certified Network Defender) or GSEC (GIAC Security Essentials)
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Experience tools for automation (building, testing, releasing or monitoring)

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Engineer III, Resilience Infrastruction and Solutions: Incident Mitigation
descriptionHtml:
At AWS, resilience is a promise to our customers: that their workloads keep running even when part of the cloud doesn't. The Resilience Infrastructure and Solutions (RIS) organization makes good on that promise, driving higher availability for AWS customers through fewer and shorter operational events. We build the services and programs that detect, mitigate, and recover from failures, from a single impaired Availability Zone to a full Region. When something goes wrong at cloud scale, our systems are what move customer traffic out of harm's way, often in under a minute, before most people notice anything happened.

You'll join a team of software engineers, product and program managers, and resilience specialists who work across AWS to raise the bar on availability. You'll partner with foundational services that depend on us as their default mitigation path, and you'll help customers protect workloads they can't afford to have go down. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Incident Mitigation team is looking for an experienced software engineer excited about building large-scale distributed systems that protect hundreds of thousands of customer resources across every AWS Region. You'll own the design and development of significant components of our mission-critical control and data planes, where correctness, speed, and scale are non-negotiable, since the moment they're needed most is during an active event. The work spans cross-service integrations with ELB, S3, EKS, DynamoDB, EC2, and other foundational services, and demands strong judgment in fault-tolerant and distributed systems design.

In this hands-on role you'll do everything from building rock-solid components to anticipating failure modes in design reviews to mentoring other engineers. You need to be not only a strong software developer with a track record of delivering, but someone who excels in communication, technical leadership, and customer focus. You'll help shape the technology and the direction of a growing, high-impact space inside AWS, writing high-quality code that measurably improves availability for every AWS customer.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of software systems spanning multiple features across the full development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are well-architected, extensible, and maintainable.
- Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, and maintainability, and guide future technology choices that align with business goals.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, technical program managers, and partner engineering teams to define requirements, align on system design, and deliver integrated solutions.
- Coach and mentor engineers on your team and across related teams, driving adoption of engineering best practices and raising the quality bar for code organization, clarity, and documentation.
- Identify opportunities to simplify existing systems and reduce technical debt, leveraging generative AI tools and industry innovations where appropriate to improve team productivity and solution quality.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing design documents and code reviews, providing guidance that helps your teammates ship high-quality software. You might then dive into a complex system design challenge, weighing trade-offs with partner teams before writing code for a critical component. Afternoons could include mentoring a fellow engineer, prototyping a new approach using generative AI tools, or leading a discussion on operational improvements. Your work will balance hands-on coding with architectural leadership, giving you the chance to shape both the technical direction and the culture of your team.

About the team
Our team is focused on building software that customers rely on every day. We value collaboration, pragmatism, and a commitment to quality that shows up in everything we build. You will work alongside talented engineers who are eager to learn from each other and solve meaningful problems together. We are investing in new capabilities and looking for someone who will help define our technical roadmap for the years ahead. If you are excited about working in an inclusive environment where your ideas shape the future of our products, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Security Engineer, Field Innovation, Security Search and Observability (SSO)
descriptionHtml:
The Field Innovation team sits inside the AWS Security, Search, Observability, and Governance service team. We work directly with customers to build next-generation security capabilities that help the world's largest enterprises get faster return on value from security, search, observability, and governance services.

We are hiring a Security Engineer to work at the intersection of customer impact and AI. Our team builds and operates the detection, correlation, and vulnerability-management capabilities behind security services such as AWS Security Hub, AWS CloudTrail, and AWS GuardDuty, as well as our newest AI-powered offering, AWS Continuum, which manages the full lifecycle of code vulnerabilities at machine speed. You'll work with customers to understand how they operate, then partner with service teams to design and ship commercial-grade security products powered by modern AI, including large language models, AI-assisted development tools, security agents, and emerging frameworks. Your code ships to real customers, and your architectural decisions will shape how Fortune 500 companies operate.

The Opportunity

Your impact here will be immediate and visible. You'll ship features that directly change how customers run their businesses, and you'll see the impact of your work in weeks, not years. The team is small enough that your decisions carry real weight and large enough that you'll always have someone to learn from.

This is a dual-facing role. On the field side, you'll work directly with customers to implement the latest features of our security services, leading threat-modeling sessions, performing vulnerability assessments with security agents, and guiding remediation. On the partner side, you'll work with leading third-party security providers to identify their highest-signal findings and turn them into correlated, high-fidelity detections. Across both, you'll design and implement detection content, reduce false positives at scale, and expand coverage across cloud resources, runtime, and AI/ML workloads. Everything you learn in the field feeds back into the product.

AI is not a side experiment on this team. It's a core part of the stack. You'll build with large language models, AI-assisted development tools, security agents, agent frameworks, and retrieval-augmented generation as everyday engineering primitives.

Key job responsibilities
• Run early-access and gated previews of our newest AI-powered capabilities with customers, including threat modeling, vulnerability assessment using security agents, and remediation guidance.
• Work backwards from customers to shape detection coverage and influence service roadmaps, feeding field and partner insights back to science and engineering teams.
• Drive detection engineering best practices, including security-value evaluation, false-positive reduction, and coverage measurement.
• Stay current with the evolving cloud security and threat landscape, including emerging threats targeting agentic AI and ML applications.
• Collaborate across science, engineering, partner, and field teams, operating with flexible hours to support global customers and distributed stakeholders.

- 3+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non-internship) experience

descriptionHtml:

title: Logistics Specialist, MEL Logistics
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Logistics Specialists play a vital role in the success of Amazon Web Services by providing the right part, in the right place at the right time. Your contribution to this success would be maintaining the onsite parts room in AWS Data Centers, by managing the custody of computer hardware through their entire lifecycle. This involves receiving parts, safely storing parts, picking and delivering parts to hardware technicians, cycle counts, and shipping faulty hardware back to the vendor.

You will work closely with Data Centre Operations and Engineering teams to ensure reliable functioning and repair activities to support our customers, while adhering to our operational tenants of safety, security and availability.

Key job responsibilities
- Maintaining inventory to ensure that proper stock levels are managed to support build and repair activities.
- Physically receiving and issuing out of parts as needed for internal customers.
- Loading, unloading and transporting parts between different sites.
- Maintaining the safety, organization, and cleanliness of all workspaces using Amazon 7S principles
- Process improvement: Analyse operational data, metrics, and existing workflows to identify opportunities for improvement. Develop and implement changes that reduce cycle times, eliminate waste, and improve SLA adherence.
- Automation: Identify repetitive, manual tasks suitable for automation, such as reporting, inventory tracking, or ticket triage, and build or propose tooling solutions to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy. This could include developing scripts, dashboards, templates, or leveraging existing internal platforms to streamline workflows.
- Standardisation: Drive consistency in how logistics operations are performed across sites within the cluster. Create or update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), checklists, and visual management aids to ensure all team members follow the same processes.
- Metrics and visibility: Develop or enhance metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms that give the team and leadership better visibility into logistics performance, enabling data-driven decision-making and faster identification of emerging issues.
- Continuous improvement culture: Proactively bring forward improvement ideas and contribute to a culture where the team is always looking for a better way to operate.

Travel:
- The role may require the successful candidate to travel to other sites in the in the Melbourne metro area to assist in conducting cycle counts, receiving stock into the inventory control system, replenishing stock and returning defective stock. Travel between sites will require own transport, all travel related costs will be reimbursed.
Process Optimisation & Automation

Physical / Environmental Demands:
- Amazon Operates with a principle of safety first. With this principle, we take significant care to ensure all employees operate in a safe manner and have appropriate tools to support them in undertaking their roles safely. The activities below are required with the safety principle applied.
- Loading and unloading shipments.
- Standing, sitting, and walking (including stairs) for prolonged periods of time.
- Willing and able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend and kneel.
- Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance.
- Push or pull heavy objects of up to 16kg into position and participate in group lifts of 20kg or more.
- Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment.
- Work with and/or around moving mechanical parts.
- Work in an office and warehouse environment where the noise level is low to moderate.

A day in the life
Your day will be spent carrying out logistical support functions across our Data Centers, ensuring that our operations teams have the parts and materials they need to keep infrastructure running. You will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of spare parts, from receiving and ingesting inbound shipments at the loading dock, to stowing parts in designated bin locations, processing break/fix and project part requests, and coordinating outbound shipments including site-to-site transfers and reverse logistics.
You will process failed parts through inventory bins, and handle Failure Analysis requests requiring parts to be shipped centrally for testing.
Inventory accuracy is a core part of the role. You will conduct regular cycle counts to maintain alignment between physical stock and system records, targeting 100% bin count completion each semester. You will review metric dashboards daily to proactively identify bins approaching SLA and take action before breaches occur.

The role also involves physical work including lifting, pushing, and pulling of materials and equipment. You will be expected to travel between sites across the cluster as needed to support operations and coverage.

About the team

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Junior Design Verification Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

The Role:
Be part of Leo's sub-team responsible for defining and implementing the digital chip SOCs for communications via Low Earth Orbit satellites and Amazon gateways. This is a unique opportunity to define a groundbreaking wireless solution with few legacy constraints. The team works with customer requirements and wireless system teams to define modems, high-speed interfaces, embedded processors, and DSP solutions in latest CMOS generation technologies.

In this role you will:
· Implement a state of the art verification environment to facilitate testing of the RTL against reference Matlab/C models
· Develop detailed test plans and write tests, run regressions, collect coverage matrices and report progress to the program
· Participate in the validation of ASIC implementations in Verilog/SystemVerilog
· Work with the design and communication systems team and participate in system level verification using test benches constructed using UVM
· Develop a highly automated environment to run regressions that can be used to make builds and maintain organization of the database


Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Communications Engineering or a related field
- 2+ years in verification preferably in communication systems
- 2+ years in UVM

Preferred qualifications

- Master's or Ph.D degree in Electrical / Communications Engineering
- 3+ years in digital verification, preferably in communication systems
- Familiarity with Matlab
- Modem design verification experience
- System C, C or Matlab model : development or DV integration experience
- Comfortable using AI-assisted tools to accelerate verification workflows (testbench generation, debug, coverage analysis).
- Familiarity with formal verification techniques
- Strong written and verbal skills

title: Ingénieur(e) en Chef DCEO, Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services recherche un(e) Ingénieur(e) en Chef rigoureux(se) et expérimenté(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO). Ce groupe s'engage à maintenir l'infrastructure physique critique qui supporte Amazon Web Services, en garantissant un fonctionnement des systèmes mécaniques, électriques et de protection incendie/sécurité à 100 % de disponibilité, tout en assurant un service client de premier ordre aux équipes opérant au sein des centres de données.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services est responsable de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. En d'autres termes, nous sommes les personnes qui font fonctionner le cloud. Nous soutenons l'ensemble des centres de données AWS ainsi que tous les serveurs, équipements de stockage, réseaux, systèmes d'alimentation électrique et de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu aux innovations sur lesquelles ils comptent. Nous travaillons sur les problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables impactant nos opérations, et nous recherchons des talents qui souhaitent nous aider à relever ces défis.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseau, de spécialistes des systèmes critiques, d'experts en sécurité, de responsables des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des collègues à travers AWS pour maintenir les plus hauts standards de sécurité tout en fournissant une capacité apparemment infinie au coût le plus bas possible pour nos clients. Vous évoluerez dans une culture inclusive qui accueille les idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à terme.

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) en Chef DCEO, vous serez responsable de veiller à ce que tous les équipements électriques, mécaniques et de sécurité incendie/sécurité des personnes au sein du centre de données fonctionnent à leur efficacité optimale. Cela implique à la fois la maintenance préventive planifiée des équipements, les travaux correctifs quotidiens et la réponse aux incidents urgents. Vous jouerez le rôle de référent(e) technique unique pour toutes les opérations des installations, en reportant au Facility Manager du site et en interagissant avec les Techniciens en Exploitation des Opérations d'Ingénierie (EOT) ainsi qu'avec les prestataires tiers. Les équipements des centres de données supportant des serveurs critiques doivent maintenir un taux de disponibilité supérieur à 99,999 %.

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) en Chef DCEO, vous gérerez des projets à impact faible à moyen, de la conception jusqu'à la livraison. Ces projets impliquent une part importante de travail en autonomie ainsi qu'une collaboration avec des équipes supports transverses incluant l'ingénierie, l'automatisation, les opérations et la finance, dans des environnements locaux et internationaux. Vous créerez et assurerez le suivi des jalons clés, obtiendrez et suivrez les devis pour tous les coûts nécessaires, et documenterez les résultats des projets pour une mise en œuvre future dans d'autres installations. L'objectif est de piloter l'innovation et la résilience tout en réduisant les coûts opérationnels.

L'un des aspects les plus enrichissants de ce rôle est de diriger, former et encadrer les Techniciens en Exploitation des Opérations d'Ingénierie dans leur mission de dépannage et d'exploitation des équipements électriques et mécaniques. Cela inclut notamment les groupes électrogènes diesel de secours, les tableaux de distribution, les onduleurs (UPS), les PDU, les unités de traitement d'air (UTA), les refroidisseurs centrifuges, les tours de refroidissement, les systèmes de traitement chimique, les pompes, les moteurs, les variateurs de fréquence (VFD) et les systèmes de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB).


Key job responsibilities
• Superviser les opérations quotidiennes et la maintenance des équipements mécaniques et électriques du centre de données.
• Travailler en autonomie avec un niveau de supervision directe limité.
• Agir en tant que point d'escalade pour tous les problèmes liés aux installations du centre de données, en escaladant au Facility Manager selon les besoins.
• Effectuer des analyses des causes racines (Root Cause Analysis) des défaillances d'équipements.
• Dépanner et signaler les événements au niveau des installations et des serveurs dans les délais SLA internes.
• Créer et déployer de nouvelles pratiques standard pour les Techniciens EOT, les Ingénieurs en Chef et les équipes prestataires.
• Assurer la formation et l'encadrement des Techniciens en Exploitation des Opérations d'Ingénierie.
• Veiller au strict respect de toutes les procédures de sécurité par les prestataires et le personnel Amazon.
• Utiliser le CMMS interne pour gérer et suivre les flux de travail des installations.
• Communiquer des informations techniques complexes à un public non technique.
• Gérer des projets d'amélioration des infrastructures de la conception à la livraison, en assurant le suivi des jalons, des coûts et des livrables.


About the team
Pourquoi AWS ?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est la plateforme cloud la plus complète et la plus largement adoptée au monde. Nous avons été pionniers du cloud computing et n'avons jamais cessé d'innover — c'est pourquoi les clients, des startups les plus prospères aux entreprises du Global 500, font confiance à notre gamme robuste de produits et services pour alimenter leurs activités.

Expériences diversifiées
Amazon valorise les expériences diversifiées. Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les qualifications et compétences préférées énumérées dans la description du poste, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Si votre carrière débute, n'a pas suivi un parcours traditionnel ou inclut des expériences alternatives, ne laissez pas cela vous empêcher de postuler.

Culture d'équipe inclusive
Chez AWS, la curiosité et la connexion humaine sont au cœur de notre identité. Nos groupes d'affinité portés par les employés et soutenus par l'entreprise favorisent l'inclusion et permettent à chacun d'être fier de ce qui le rend unique. Nos événements d'inclusion renforcent des équipes plus soudées et plus collaboratives. Notre innovation continue est alimentée par les idées audacieuses, les perspectives nouvelles et les voix passionnées que nos équipes apportent à tout ce que nous faisons.

Mentorat et évolution de carrière
Nous élevons continuellement notre barre de performance dans notre quête pour devenir le Meilleur Employeur au Monde. C'est pourquoi vous trouverez ici un partage de connaissances infini, du mentorat et d'autres ressources d'avancement professionnel pour vous aider à devenir un professionnel plus accompli.

Équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle
Nous valorisons l'harmonie entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Réussir au travail ne devrait jamais se faire au détriment de sacrifices à la maison, c'est pourquoi nous nous efforçons d'offrir de la flexibilité dans notre culture de travail. Lorsque nous nous sentons soutenus sur le lieu de travail et à la maison, il n'y a rien que nous ne puissions accomplir dans le cloud.

- Diplôme de niveau Bac+3 minimum en Génie Électrique, Génie Mécanique, CVC, Technologie Industrielle ou Génie Électrotechnique
- Minimum 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans un centre de données ou tout autre environnement critique

- Familiarité avec les environnements opérationnels critiques 24h/24, 7j/7, 365 jours par an
- Aptitude à communiquer des informations techniques complexes à des interlocuteurs non techniques

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. title: Sr. Product Manager Tech - Selling Partner Compliance, Tax & Account Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Join a high-impact team at the forefront of global compliance innovation, where you'll shape how Amazon keeps its compliance posture sound as regulations multiply across jurisdictions and programs. Meeting a regulatory obligation at launch is only the beginning — knowing whether our controls continue to hold as the business grows, regulations evolve, and new risk areas emerge is what separates durable compliance from a check that silently decays. You'll own the product vision for that continuous risk view, building the platform that turns compliance signals into timely, proportionate action — and makes the whole system smarter every cycle.

The Selling Partner Trust & Store Integrity team is seeking a strong Sr. Product Manager, Tech to own Risk Monitoring & Response — the capability that continuously assesses our compliance-risk posture and decides what each risk signal should trigger. You own the layer that monitors compliance risk over time and converts it into action: risk-based routing, the assessment framework that maps a risk signal to a proportionate response, the triggers that keep compliance current as circumstances change, and the instrumentation that makes risk posture visible to the business — productized into a scalable, increasingly automated capability that applies across programs and compliance domains. Alongside this capability, you serve as the named product lead for a set of compliance programs and regulatory risk areas — holding the end-to-end product view: partnering with program, legal, and compliance stakeholders to understand each obligation, translating it into durable product requirements, and connecting regulatory intent to the capabilities that keep sellers and the store compliant. Assignments are reviewed periodically and evolve as programs mature and new regulatory areas emerge. This role requires navigating complex cross-functional stakeholder landscapes while balancing regulatory requirements, technical constraints, and delivery velocity.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for compliance risk monitoring and response — how Amazon continuously assesses whether its compliance posture is holding, where risk is concentrated, and how each program responds, across programs, regions, and compliance domains
- Serve as the named product lead for an assigned portfolio of compliance programs and regulatory risk areas — translating regulatory obligations into durable product requirements and holding the end-to-end product view
- Partner with analytics and applied science to define and instrument the right compliance metrics per program, and to turn those signals into productized, data-driven decisions
- Design the capability as a 1-to-many platform — reusable and policy-agnostic, so new programs, jurisdictions, and risk areas onboard via configuration rather than custom builds
- Define success metrics and monitoring — program coverage, time to surface emerging risk, share of responses driven by the shared framework vs. one-off logic, and reduction in reactive escalations
- Present product strategy and investment cases to Director- and VP-level audiences, securing alignment across multiple VP organizations with competing priorities
- Partner with applied science, principal engineering, program management, legal/compliance, and peer product owners to deliver end-to-end at scale

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience

descriptionHtml:

title: Sr Tech Product Manager, Customer Fulfillment Experience
descriptionHtml:
Brazil Customer Fulfillment Experience (CFX) is looking for a Sr. Technical Product Manager to own BR CFX product development in partnership with our global teams. As a Sr. Product Manager, you will be responsible for customer experiences with considerable scope and complexity — whether a complete product, a significant capability within a platform, or a customer-facing experience requiring cross-team coordination. You will own products development management and design business requirements (technical and functional) with meaningful technical difficulty: products that may appear simple on the surface but are deeply technical, sit within complex systems, and require both strong technology judgment and business domain knowledge to make the right trade-offs.

In this role, the problem, opportunity, and strategy are often not pre-defined. You will use your expertise and judgment to determine the right goals and design long-term solutions, taking the lead on initiatives and delivering independently while seeking direction when needed. You will act as the Voice of the Customer across Promise, Messaging, Address, and Returns experiences — resolving customer trustbusters, improving non-Prime settlement rates, reducing address-led undeliverable defects, and unlocking Speed and ship-fee experimentation. Your work will create value through measurable outcomes across customer experience, brand, business growth, and operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
- Own vision and strategy - Define the vision (PR/FAQ), problem statement, tenets, and strategy for your product area. Own the roadmap and priorities, making crisp decisions about what moves forward and in what order.
- Serve as Voice of the Customer - Generalize requirements across diverse customer personas and use cases (Prime and non-Prime) and multiple business channels. Work backward from customer needs, engaging customers directly, and distinguish representative signal from anecdotal feedback using VOC connects, DEX generative studies, support tickets, and usage data.
- Drive deep technical engagement - Understand the core technologies and architecture behind your product — workflows, APIs, runtime characteristics, design limitations, and maintenance requirements. Evaluate technical proposals for extensibility, performance, and scalability; recognize when a design limits scale or future innovation; and know when a design warrants deeper review from a Principal Engineer. You may define technical requirements for APIs and algorithms.
- Make data-informed decisions - Define success criteria, KPIs, and metrics, distinguishing output metrics (adoption) from outcome metrics (customer satisfaction, business impact). Find the highest-leverage input metrics in operational reviews (WBR/MBR), and drive decisions with judgment when data is incomplete.
- Balance trade-offs - Hold the tension between business outcomes and customer value, keeping customer value as the primary lens. Balance short-term delivery pressure with long-term architectural integrity, and know when technical shortcuts create unacceptable debt versus when pragmatic trade-offs accelerate learning.
- Partner on experience and delivery - Work with design and engineering on mockups, prototypes, and acceptance criteria; balance compliance, localization, and accessibility constraints; own launches and performance before and after launch; and monitor operational health, addressing issues with appropriate urgency.
- Lead cross-functionally - Influence without authority across engineering, science, design, finance, legal, marketing, and operations. Write strategic narratives (6-pagers, PR/FAQs), contribute to planning cycles, and drive product discussions with senior managers and Directors regularly, and VPs occasionally.
- Prioritize operational excellence - Understand the impact of technical backlog on a product's future and the team's ability to execute, and prioritize operational excellence work alongside feature delivery on the roadmap.
- Apply AI leverage - Assess how AI capabilities reshape product architectures, recognize when AI enhances versus complicates design, and use AI to accelerate prototyping, specification, documentation, and insight generation.

A day in the life
- Morning: review customer and data signal. You start by reviewing WBR/MBR dashboards for delivery-promise and returns trends, scanning the highest-leverage input metrics and a batch of VOC comments from the latest monthly connect. You spot a pattern in address-led undeliverable defects and open a dive-deep doc to frame the underlying problem rather than the surface request.
- Mid-morning: start technical depth reviews. You join an architecture review with Senior Engineers to evaluate a proposed change to the Promise service. You probe extensibility and scale implications, surface a technical-debt risk, and agree the design warrants a quick Principal Engineer review before commitment.
- Midday: writing and review business strategies. You block focus time to advance a PR/FAQ for a non-Prime delivery experience experiment, reasoning from first principles about one-way versus two-way door decisions and defining the success metrics.
- Afternoon: cross-functional alignment. You align with design on a messaging prototype, sync with Legal on a localization/compliance constraint, and work with a partner team in EM or central teams on a regional customization — accepting it only where the benefit clearly outweighs technical debt and operational burden.
- Late afternoon: delivery and stakeholders. You unblock engineering on acceptance criteria for an upcoming launch, review post-launch operational health on a recent feature, and prep a short narrative update for a Sr. Leadership review. You close the day mentoring a junior PM on how to separate representative signal from anecdote.

About the team
BR CFX, Speed & Delivery CX
The BR CFX CX workstream was created with a vision to build a delightful, easy-to-navigate, and reliable experience by resolving customer trustbusters across the shopping journey, customer types, and key functional areas — Promise, Messaging, Address, and Returns. The team is a ring-fenced two-pizza team built on the hypothesis that these investments drive higher engagement with Prime customers, improve non-Prime settlement rate %, reduce address-led undeliverable defect rate, and create revenue streams via Speed marketing and ship-fee experiments.

- What we own: Our key feature areas are Address (reducing address-led undeliverable defect rate), Prime Delivery Experience, and Non-Prime Delivery Experience — spanning India and Emerging Markets.
- How we stay close to the customer: VOC through monthly and quarterly connects; quarterly DEX generative studies to understand customer comprehension and benchmark our features; and WBR/MBR mechanisms for customer trends.

Our tenets (unless you know better):
- As guardians of the delivery and returns experience in BR, we build customer trust by maintaining clarity, consistency, and accuracy across touch points and delivery programs, keeping features flexible enough to cover the breadth of programs and relying on data to justify program-level customizations.
- We earn customers' trust and maximize long-term value, rather than optimizing for short-term profit or individual programs.
- We power the delivery and returns CX using accurate data from upstream sources.
- We prioritize customizations in the best interest of customers, experimenting with regional customizations and accepting those where the benefit greatly outweighs the technical debt and operational burden.
- We treat automated testing as a prerequisite to submitting code and avoid reliance on manual testing.
- As stewards of BR delivery and returns CX, new programs or CX changes in BR are reviewed and approved by this team.
The team brings together Product (Principal and Senior PMs), Engineering (Senior Engineers, SDEs, QAE, and Support Engineers), and Program/Delivery management, partnering closely across BR.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Solid product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

title: HR Consultant Apprentice - 24 month Fixed Term Contract
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about people, and curious about what makes a great workplace actually work? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join Amazon as an HR Consultant Apprentice - a role where the decisions you support shape the day-to-day experience of thousands of employees.

HR at Amazon isn't about admin and policy for their own sake. Our teams sit alongside business leaders, using data, insight, and well-designed mechanisms to help managers lead well, grow their people, and make fair, consistent decisions at real scale.

As an apprentice, you'll learn this craft by doing it. You'll start by supporting the fundamentals and, over time, take on real responsibility - getting closer to the business, forming your own point of view, and learning how to influence outcomes rather than simply respond to requests.

A day in the life can involve:

- Partnering with managers and stakeholders to offer expert, practical HR guidance

- Contributing to diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

- Supporting the delivery of HR strategy for the lines of business you work with

- Using people data to spot trends and shape fair, consistent decisions

- Helping standardise and improve best practice across teams

This role suits someone who's genuinely curious about people and comfortable with a bit of grey - not every answer is in a handbook. You'll build credibility with colleagues at every level, ask good questions, and bring empathy and sound judgement to situations that are rarely black and white. We move fast, fail fast, and fix faster, so you'll be encouraged to form a view and act on it early.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship you'll put newfound knowledge into practice every day, supported by first-class coaching, tailored development, and rewarding work that will empower you to reach new heights and build the future you envision.

You'll gain a vast range of experiences and skills while working towards the HR Consultant Partner Level 5 apprenticeship standard and the CIPD Level 5 certification in People Management. As a working student, your focus is to complete your studies in your 20% off-the-job time, developing the skills, knowledge, and behaviours to work towards successful graduation. You'll be set goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

You'll build your skills over a 24-month period, starting in September. Your apprenticeship will combine classroom/virtual-based training to cover knowledge, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, online learning, and mentoring from our experienced team members.

We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups – including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities – provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're also continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer, so you'll have the resources and support to develop into a well-rounded professional.

Your career isn't a straight path - it's a journey you build as you go. A universe of opportunity awaits, and your next adventure starts here.

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in England at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in England for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- Hold 5 GCSEs at grade 4-9 (A-C) or above (or equivalent) including Maths and English and 3 A Levels or equivalent qualifications (at grade C or above) or a T-Level Pass
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 24 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- A genuine interest in people, behaviour, and what makes a workplace work well - whether through study, a part-time role, volunteering, or simply being the person others come to
- Some experience of working with or helping others in any setting (for example a customer-facing role, team project, club, or community activity)

As one of the world's most advanced technology-driven companies, we're powered by automation, robotics, and continuous innovation - from robotic arms to complex conveyor networks and smart sensor technology that keep millions of customer orders moving. This apprenticeship gives you the chance to become a multi-skilled maintenance technician across both electrical and mechanical disciplines, with hands-on experience on industry-leading equipment, some of which only exists at Amazon.

Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is fundamental to our operations - they keep vital machinery running around the clock. As an RME Mechatronics Apprentice, you'll help maintain a wide range of equipment while upholding Health and Safety best practice, keeping your colleagues safe, preventing downtime, and improving the availability and quality of our equipment.

You'll thrive here if you stay calm when things go wrong and get a real kick out of fixing them. You're hands-on, curious about how machines work, and you understand that keeping production moving is what it's all about. And you don't need to be a qualified engineer to start - what matters most is a practical, problem-solving mindset and a hunger to learn.

A day in the life can involve:

- Carrying out proactive and preventative maintenance
- Carrying out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Using the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Making modifications and upgrades to existing equipment
- Upholding health and safety policies and practices
- Working on continuous improvement projects, and suggesting long-term improvements

Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll build a broad, in-demand engineering skillset, including:

- Fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance
- Mechanical device maintenance, and fluid power systems assembly and testing
- Electrical equipment wiring and testing
- Hydraulics and pneumatics
- Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) operations
- CAD design and 3D printing

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

Throughout the apprenticeship you'll work towards an Advanced Apprenticeship in Engineering (Mechatronics Maintenance), combining practical, on-the-job experience with industry-recognised study. Your first 12 months will be a full-time residential programme, based either at one of our external training provider facilities or at our own world-class Amazon training centres - reflecting our significant investment in developing state-of-the-art facilities for the next generation of engineers. If you live outside a commutable distance, accommodation will be provided during term time for these first 12 months, and travel expenses will be supported.

Please note: some of our training sites aren't accessible by public transport, so you'll need to be able to arrange reliable travel to and from site. Access to a car can make this easier but isn't essential.

In later years, you'll combine day or block-release study for your HNC in Engineering or Mechatronics with on-the-job training at one of our Fulfilment Centres, Sortation Centres, or Delivery Stations, learning directly from experienced technicians and engineers and gaining exposure to real engineering projects.

This role supports our 24/7 operation, so you'll work shifts covering days, nights and weekends - patterns that reflect the real-world schedules of the engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock.

This apprenticeship trains you for a variety of maintenance roles - mechatronic maintenance technician, maintenance engineer, mechanical fitter, and electrical engineer - with plenty of opportunities for progression both within RME and more widely across Amazon. This could be the start of an exciting and rewarding career.

You'll join a diverse and passionate team of engineers dedicated to driving results and pushing creative boundaries. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups - including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a well-rounded professional.

Join us and be part of the team that keeps Amazon moving. Apply now and shape the future of technology with us.

As part of the recruitment and enrolment process for this apprenticeship, candidates must provide proof of all required qualifications. Original certificates or certified copies must be submitted - this is a mandatory requirement to secure the position. The deadline for providing qualification certificates for the RME Mechatronics programme is 16 July 2027. Applications without verified qualifications by this date will automatically be unsuccessful, and failure to provide proof by the deadline will result in the withdrawal of any conditional offer, meaning you will not be able to commence the programme. Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility, and offers may be withdrawn for applicants who do not meet the funding criteria.

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in Wales at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in Wales for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- Have a minimum of 3 GCSEs at Grade 4 (C) or above (or equivalent), including Maths, English, and a Science or Technology subject.
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 36 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- A genuine interest in engineering, machines, and how automated systems work
- A practical, hands-on approach and enjoyment of taking things apart to understand and fix them
- Great problem-solving skills and the ability to stay calm and methodical when things go wrong
- Good attention to detail and an awareness of health and safety
- An eagerness to learn, take on new challenges, and grow professionally
- Willing and able to work shifts, including days, nights and weekends
- Able to arrange reliable travel to and from training sites, some of which aren't served by public transport other than taxi (access to a car can help but isn't essential)

title: Software Development Engineer II, Client Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Client Engineering organization builds and operates the technology that manages a large-scale corporate computing fleet across Windows and macOS. Our mission is to make endpoint management secure, reliable, measurable, and increasingly autonomous.

We are building the next generation of Client Engineering capabilities: an autonomous fleet management platform that can understand endpoint state, identify risks and drift, make intelligent decisions, safely execute changes, and continuously verify the outcome—with humans involved when judgment or risk requires it.

This is not traditional desktop engineering or a simple device-management role. You will build distributed software systems that operate across hundreds of thousands of endpoints and directly impact how employees work every day.

The Role:
As a Software Development Engineer on the Client Engineering Autonomous Fleet Management team, you will design and build systems that enable autonomous endpoint operations at scale.

You will work across the endpoint, cloud, data, automation, and observability layers to build capabilities such as:

- Automated OS and application update orchestration
- Endpoint policy and configuration management
- Fleet health and compliance evaluation
- Configuration and software drift detection
- Safe rollout and deployment automation
- Automated endpoint remediation and recovery
- Automated incident detection, investigation, and resolution
- Intelligent identification and remediation of endpoint failures

You will help evolve endpoint management from a collection of administrative tools into a software-defined, autonomous operating platform.



Key job responsibilities
Build Autonomous Fleet Management Systems:
Design and develop highly scalable services and control-plane capabilities for endpoint policy, configuration, software, OS updates, compliance, and fleet state across a large enterprise environment.

Automate Endpoint Operations and Remediation:
Build intelligent automation that detects endpoint issues, configuration drift, and compliance gaps; determines appropriate actions; executes remediation; and verifies the endpoint has returned to the desired state.

Build Safe, Progressive Deployment Systems:
Develop rollout, canary, ring, health-gating, rollback, and recovery mechanisms that enable fleet-wide changes to be deployed safely while continuously measuring customer and endpoint impact.

Develop Fleet Observability and Intelligence:
Build telemetry, diagnostics, anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis capabilities that transform endpoint signals into actionable insights and automated operational decisions.

Engineer Reliable, Secure, and Scalable Platforms:
Own production-quality software from architecture through operation, designing for scale, reliability, security, resilience, and measurable service-level objectives while contributing to the technical direction of autonomous Client Engineering.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
